/** Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle begins. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationStartEvent {
  type: "span.outcome_evaluation_start";
  /** Unique identifier for this event. */
  id: string;
  /** 0-indexed revision cycle. 0 is the first evaluation; 1 is the re-evaluation after the first revision; etc. */
  iteration: number; // format: int32
  /** The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated. */
  outcome_id: string;
  /** Timestamp when outcome evaluation started. */
  processed_at: string; // format: date-time
}

/** Emitted when an outcome evaluation cycle completes. Carries the verdict and aggregate token usage. A verdict of `needs_revision` means another evaluation cycle follows; `satisfied`, `max_iterations_reached`, `failed`, or `interrupted` are terminal — no further evaluation cycles follow. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEndEvent {
  type: "span.outcome_evaluation_end";
  /** Unique identifier for this event. */
  id: string;
  /** Human-readable explanation of the verdict. For `needs_revision`, describes which criteria failed and why. */
  explanation: string;
  /** 0-indexed revision cycle, matching the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start`. */
  iteration: number; // format: int32
  /** The id of the corresponding `span.outcome_evaluation_start` event. */
  outcome_evaluation_start_id: string;
  /** The `outc_` ID of the outcome being evaluated. */
  outcome_id: string;
  /** Timestamp when outcome evaluation ended. */
  processed_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Evaluation verdict. 'satisfied': criteria met, session goes idle. 'needs_revision': criteria not met, another revision cycle follows. 'max_iterations_reached': evaluation budget exhausted with criteria still unmet — one final acknowledgment turn follows before the session goes idle, but no further evaluation runs. 'failed': grader determined the rubric does not apply to the deliverables. 'interrupted': user sent an interrupt while evaluation was in progress. */
  result: string;
  /** Aggregate token usage for this evaluation cycle. Sums across all grader model requests within the cycle. */
  usage: BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelUsage;
}

}

  /** The id of the `agent.tool_use` event this result corresponds to, which can be found in the last `session.status_idle` [event's](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/events/list?sdk_languages=typescript#beta_managed_agents_session_requires_action.event_ids) `stop_reason.event_ids` field. */
  tool_use_id: string;

  is_error?: boolean | null;
  /** Timestamp when this result was processed. */
  processed_at?: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Set by the server to the subagent thread this result was routed to. Omitted when it was routed to the primary thread. */
  session_thread_id?: string | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
}

/** A session thread hit a transient error and is retrying automatically. Emitted on the thread's own stream and cross-posted to the primary stream for child threads. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRescheduledEvent {

/** Emitted when an UpdateSession request changed at least one field. Carries only the fields that changed; absent fields were not part of the update. The new configuration applies from the next turn. */

  agent?: BetaManagedAgentsSessionAgent | null;
  /** The session's budget after the update: the new budget when set or replaced, or null when the update removed it. Present only when the update changed the budget. */
  budget?: BetaManagedAgentsBudgetLimit | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
  /** The session's full metadata bag after the update. Present when the update set non-empty metadata; absent when metadata was unchanged or cleared to empty. */
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;
  /** The session's new title. Present only when the update changed it. */

  /** Timestamp when this event was processed. */

type BetaManagedAgentsAgentEvaluatedPermission = "allow" | "ask" | "deny";

type BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluation = BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAlwaysAllow | BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAlwaysAsk | BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAuto;

/** The resolved permission_policy was always_allow; accompanies evaluated_permission "allow". */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAlwaysAllow {
  type: "always_allow";
}

/** The resolved permission_policy was always_ask; accompanies evaluated_permission "ask". */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAlwaysAsk {
  type: "always_ask";
}

/** The resolved permission_policy was auto: the server judged this invocation individually. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolEvaluationAuto {
  type: "auto";
  /** The server's judgement for this invocation. */
  evaluated_permission: BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermission;
}

type BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermission = BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionAllow | BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionAsk | BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionDeny;

/** The server judged the invocation safe to execute without client approval. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionAllow {
  type: "allow";
}

/** The server reached no judgement; the invocation is held for client approval. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionAsk {
  type: "ask";
  /** The judgement's grounds in registry-bound terms, for client branching and audit rather than end-user display. Open registry; currently "indeterminate" (no judgement was reached). Clients must tolerate values outside this set. */
  reason_code: string; // maxLength: 64
}

/** The server judged the invocation high-risk, or reached no judgement and did not hold it for client approval (for example, because the organization is out of credits or has reached a spend limit); it does not execute and a synthetic error tool result is appended. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentAutoEvaluatedPermissionDeny {
  type: "deny";
  /** The judgement's grounds in registry-bound terms. Open registry; currently "high_risk" (judged high-risk; the call does not run) and "indeterminate" (no judgement was reached; the call does not run). Clients must tolerate values outside this set. */
  reason_code: string; // maxLength: 64
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionRefusalStopDetails {
  type: "refusal";
  /** The policy category that triggered the refusal, or `null` when there is no named category. New values can be added over time. */
  category: "cyber" | "bio" | "frontier_llm" | "reasoning_extraction" | "general_harms" | null;
  /** Human-readable explanation of the refusal, or `null` when none is available. The wording can change, so do not parse it. */
  explanation: string | null;
}

/** The agent completed its turn naturally and is ready for the next user message. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionEndTurn {
  type: "end_turn";
}

/** The agent is idle waiting on one or more blocking user-input events (tool confirmation, custom tool result, etc.). Resolving all of them transitions the session back to running. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionRequiresAction {
  type: "requires_action";
  /** The ids of events the agent is blocked on. Resolving fewer than all re-emits `session.status_idle` with the remainder. */
  event_ids: Array<string>;
}

/** The turn ended because repeated errors exhausted the retry budget or an error escalated to `retry_status: 'exhausted'`. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionRetriesExhausted {
  type: "retries_exhausted";
}

/** The agent stopped because the session's tracked list cost reached its budget, or because its usage includes a model with no list price (which the budget cannot measure). Raise the budget to continue — or, if raising is rejected because a model has no list price, remove the budget. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionBudgetReached {
  type: "budget_reached";
}

/** The turn ended because the model's response was refused, for example by a safety classifier. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionRefusal {
  type: "refusal";
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelUsage {
  /** Tokens used to create prompt cache in this request. */
  cache_creation_input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** Tokens read from prompt cache in this request. */
  cache_read_input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** Input tokens consumed by this request. */
  input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** Output tokens generated by this request. */
  output_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** Inference speed tier this request actually ran at. Mirrors `usage.speed` on /v1/messages. Only present when the fast-mode beta is active. */

interface BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock {

}

interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageSnapshot {

  active_seconds?: number; // format: double
  /** Tokens used to create prompt cache entries, broken down by cache TTL. */

  /** Total tokens read from prompt cache. */

  /** Total input tokens consumed across all turns. */

  /** Total output tokens generated across all turns. */

type BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResult = BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultCompleted | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultError | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunResultStopped;

/** The run's plan, a program that the agent wrote, finished. This does not say whether the work succeeded. */

}

/** The run failed or reached its time limit. */

/** The agent stopped the run. */

}

type BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunError = BetaManagedAgentsTimeoutWorkflowRunError | BetaManagedAgentsProgramWorkflowRunError | BetaManagedAgentsUnknownWorkflowRunError | BetaManagedAgentsThreadLimitWorkflowRunError | BetaManagedAgentsMaxWorkflowRunsWorkflowRunError;

/** The run reached its time limit. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsTimeoutWorkflowRunError {
  type: "timeout_error";
  /** Short explanation written by the server. It never contains content from the run or its agents. */
  message: string;
}

/** The plan, a program that the agent wrote, failed, or the server refused it. */

  type: "program_error";
  /** Short explanation written by the server. It never contains content from the run or its agents. */
  message: string;
}

/** A failure that has no type of its own. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsUnknownWorkflowRunError {
  type: "unknown_error";
  /** Short explanation written by the server. It never contains content from the run or its agents. */
  message: string;
}

/** The run exceeded the limit on the number of threads that a run can create. */

  type: "thread_limit_error";
  /** Short explanation written by the server. It never contains content from the run or its agents. */

/** No run was created, because the session was at its limit of open workflow runs, which are runs that have not ended. Only `workflow_run.error` carries this type. */

  /** Short explanation written by the server. It never contains content from the run or its agents. */
  message: string;
}

/** An unknown or unexpected error occurred during session execution. A fallback variant; clients that don't recognize a new error code can match on `retry_status` and `message` alone. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsUnknownError {
  type: "unknown_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
  /** What the client should do next. */
  retry_status: BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusRetrying | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusExhausted | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusTerminal;
}

  /** What the client should do next. */

  retry_status: BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusRetrying | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusExhausted | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusTerminal;

The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn. */

/** The turn stopped because the context was compacted the maximum number of times in a row without the model producing a message or a tool call, not because a request failed. The thread goes idle with `stop_reason: retries_exhausted` (a child thread then terminates); the next `user.message` starts a new turn. */

  retry_status: BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusRetrying | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusExhausted | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusTerminal;

/** The requested branch or commit does not exist in the repository. */

  type: "repository_checkout_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
  /** URL of the repository that could not be cloned. Null when it could not be identified. */
  repository_url: string | null;
  /** What the client should do next. Always `retrying`: the session keeps running without the repository. */
  retry_status: BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusRetrying | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusExhausted | BetaManagedAgentsRetryStatusTerminal;

/** The repository could not be cloned. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsRepositoryCloneError {

  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
  /** URL of the repository that could not be cloned. Null when it could not be identified. */

/** This turn is dead; queued inputs are flushed and the session returns to idle. Client may send a new prompt. */

```

### Send Events

- Signature: `client.beta.sessions.events.send(sessionID: string, params: EventSendParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaManagedAgentsSendSessionEvents`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: managed-agents-2026-04-01`

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaManagedAgentsSendSessionEvents = await client.beta.sessions.events.send(
  "sesn_011CZkZAtmR3yMPDzynEDxu7",
  {
    events: [
      { content: [{ text: "Where is my order #1234?", type: "text" }], type: "user.message" }
    ]
  }
);

console.log(betaManagedAgentsSendSessionEvents.data);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "sevt_011CZkZGPp1iBcp4kaQSihUm",
      "content": [
        {
          "text": "Where is my order #1234?",
          "type": "text"
        }
      ],
      "type": "user.message",
      "processed_at": "2026-03-15T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
sessionID: string; // path parameter

interface EventSendParams {
  /** Events to send to the `session`. */
  events: Array<BetaManagedAgentsEventParams>;
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `managed-agents-2026-04-01` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter

/** Server-sent event in the session stream. */
type BetaManagedAgentsStreamSessionEvents = BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEvent | BetaManagedAgentsUserInterruptEvent | BetaManagedAgentsUserToolConfirmationEvent | BetaManagedAgentsUserCustomToolResultEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentCustomToolUseEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessageEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentThinkingEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentMCPToolUseEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentMCPToolResultEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolUseEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolResultEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageReceivedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadMessageSentEvent | BetaManagedAgentsAgentThreadContextCompactedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionErrorEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRescheduledEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusRunningEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusIdleEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionStatusTerminatedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadCreatedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationStartEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationEndEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestStartEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSpanModelRequestEndEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSpanOutcomeEvaluationOngoingEvent | BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionDeletedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRunningEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusIdleEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusTerminatedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsUserToolResultEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatusRescheduledEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionUpdatedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsStartEvent | BetaManagedAgentsDeltaEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEvent | BetaManagedAgentsSessionUsageEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunCreatedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusEndedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseStartedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunPhaseEndedEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusRunningEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunStatusIdleEvent | BetaManagedAgentsWorkflowRunErrorEvent;
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaManagedAgentsDeltaType = "agent.message" | "agent.thinking";

/** Opens a preview of a buffered event. Carries the previewed event's type and id only. Followed by zero or more event_delta events with the same event id, normally concluded by the buffered event carrying that id. If the producing model request ends without that event (an error or interrupt mid-stream), its terminal span.model_request_end closes the preview. Only sent on stream connections that opt in via event_deltas; never appears in event history. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsStartEvent {
  type: "event_start";
  /** The previewed event's type and id. The event type determines which delta types the preview's event_delta events carry: agent.message events stream content_delta fragments; agent.thinking previews are start-only — no deltas follow, and the buffered agent.thinking with the same id concludes them. */
  event: BetaManagedAgentsStartEventPreview;
}

/** An incremental update to an event that is still being streamed. Deltas are best-effort and may stop early; when the buffered event with id == event_id is produced it carries the complete content. A model request that ends early (an error or interrupt) produces no buffered event — its terminal span.model_request_end closes the preview. Only sent on stream connections that opt in via event_deltas; never appears in event history. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeltaEvent {
  type: "event_delta";
  /** One fragment of the previewed event. The delta type is named for the previewed event's field it streams into: agent.message events stream content_delta fragments, each a partial element of the content array. */
  delta: BetaManagedAgentsDeltaContent;
  /** The id of the event being previewed. Matches event.id on the corresponding event_start and the buffered event that reconciles the preview. */
  event_id: string;
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsDeltaContent {
  type: "content_delta";
  /** A partial element of the content array at index, typed like the element itself — the same shape the buffered agent.message carries in content. */
  content: BetaManagedAgentsTextBlock;
  /** Which entry in the previewed event's content array this fragment lands in. Insert content as that entry when the index is new; append to the existing entry otherwise. */
  index?: number;
}

type BetaManagedAgentsStartEventPreview = BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessagePreview | BetaManagedAgentsAgentThinkingPreview;

interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentMessagePreview {
  type: "agent.message";
  /** The id the buffered agent.message will carry if it is emitted. Matches the event_id on this preview's event_delta events. */
  id: string;
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentThinkingPreview {
  type: "agent.thinking";
  /** The id the buffered agent.thinking will carry if it is emitted. Start-only — no event_delta events follow. */
  id: string;
}
```

/** An execution thread within a `session`. Each session has one primary thread plus zero or more child threads. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionThread {
  type: "session_thread";
  /** Unique identifier for this thread. */
  id: string;
  /** Resolved agent definition for this thread. Snapshot of the agent at thread creation time. */
  agent: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadAgent | BetaManagedAgentsAdvisor | BetaManagedAgentsInlineAgent;
  /** When the thread was archived. Null if not archived. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** When the thread was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Parent thread that spawned this thread. Null for the primary thread. */
  parent_thread_id: string | null;
  /** The session this thread belongs to. */
  session_id: string;
  /** Timing statistics for this thread. Null until the thread's first status transition. */
  stats: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStats | null;
  /** Current execution status of the thread. */
  status: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatus;
  /** When the thread was last updated. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Cumulative token usage for this thread. Null until the thread's first idle transition. */
  usage: BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadUsage | null;
  /** Identifier of the workflow run that created the thread, or `null` for any other thread. */
  workflow_run_id: string | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
}
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStatus = "running" | "idle" | "rescheduling" | "terminated";

/** An agent that has no Agent resource, and so no `id` or `version`. It is defined inline, in a workflow run's plan or when a session thread is spawned, and is not saved. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsInlineAgent {
  type: "inline";
  description: string | null;
  /** The session's execution principal. */
  execution_identity: BetaManagedAgentsExecutionIdentity; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
  mcp_servers: Array<BetaManagedAgentsMCPServerURLDefinition>;
  /** Model identifier and configuration. */
  model: BetaManagedAgentsModelConfig;
  /** The name that the agent's definition gave, or one that the server assigned. */
  name: string;
  skills: Array<BetaManagedAgentsAnthropicSkill | BetaManagedAgentsCustomSkill>;
  system: string | null;
  tools: Array<BetaManagedAgentsAgentToolset20260401 | BetaManagedAgentsMCPToolset | BetaManagedAgentsCustomTool>;
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadStats {
  /** Cumulative time in seconds the thread spent actively running. Excludes idle time. */
  active_seconds?: number; // format: double
  /** Elapsed time since thread creation in seconds. For archived threads, frozen at the final update. */
  duration_seconds?: number; // format: double
  /** Time in seconds for the thread to begin running. Zero for child threads, which start immediately. */
  startup_seconds?: number; // format: double
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionThreadUsage {
  /** Cumulative time in seconds this thread spent in running status. Equal to `stats.active_seconds`; surfaced here so a thread's usage carries every quantity its cost is priced on. */
  active_seconds?: number; // format: double, beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
  /** Tokens used to create prompt cache entries, broken down by cache TTL. */
  cache_creation?: BetaManagedAgentsCacheCreationUsage;
  /** Total tokens read from prompt cache. */
  cache_read_input_tokens?: number; // format: int32
  /** Total input tokens consumed across all turns. */
  input_tokens?: number; // format: int32
  /** Cumulative list cost of this thread across all turns, priced at public list rates. Absent until cost tracking is available for the thread. Each figure is rounded to the nearest cent independently and the session's aggregate `usage.list_cost` additionally includes session runtime, so per-thread costs do not sum exactly to the session figure; the session figure is authoritative and is what a budget is enforced against. */
  list_cost?: BetaMonetaryAmount | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
  /** Total output tokens generated across all turns. */
  output_tokens?: number; // format: int32
  /** Cumulative server-executed tool usage across all turns of this thread. Absent until server-tool tracking is available for the thread. */
  server_tool_use?: BetaManagedAgentsServerToolUsage | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
}
```

  /** Human-readable name for the deployment. */
  name: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 256
  /** Enforced spend ceiling stamped onto each session created from this deployment, copied at session-creation time. Omit to leave sessions uncapped. The deployment agent's model must have a public list price, or the request is rejected; a multiagent roster is re-validated in full when each fire copies the cap, which fails closed the same way. */
  budget?: BetaManagedAgentsBudgetLimit | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
  /** Description of what the deployment does. */
  description?: string | null; // maxLength: 2048
  /** Arbitrary key-value metadata. Maximum 16 pairs, keys up to 64 chars, values up to 512 chars. */
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Resources (e.g. repositories, files) to mount into each session's container. Maximum 500. */
  resources?: Array<BetaManagedAgentsGitHubRepositoryResourceParams | BetaManagedAgentsFileResourceParams | BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResourceParam>;
  /** Optional recurring cron schedule. When present, the deployment fires automatically. Both expression and timezone are required when schedule is set. */
  schedule?: BetaManagedAgentsScheduleParams | null;
  /** Vault IDs for stored credentials the agent can use during sessions created from this deployment. Maximum 50. */
  vault_ids?: Array<string>;
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `managed-agents-2026-04-01` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter

Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** A deployment is a configured instance of an agent — it binds the agent to everything needed to run it autonomously: an environment, credentials, initial events, and an optional schedule. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeployment {
  type: "deployment";
  /** Unique identifier for this deployment. */
  id: string;
  /** Reference to the agent this deployment runs, resolved to a concrete version. */
  agent: BetaManagedAgentsAgentReference;
  /** Time the deployment was archived. Null if not archived. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Time the deployment was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Description of what the deployment does. */
  description: string | null;
  /** ID of the `environment` where sessions run. */
  environment_id: string;
  /** Events sent to each session immediately after creation. */
  initial_events: Array<BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentInitialEvent>;
  /** Arbitrary key-value metadata. Maximum 16 pairs. */
  metadata: Record<string, string>;
  /** Human-readable name. */
  name: string;
  /** Why the deployment is `paused`. Non-null exactly when `status` is `paused`; null otherwise. */
  paused_reason: BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReason | null;
  /** Resources attached to sessions created from this deployment. Echoes the input minus write-only credentials. */
  resources: Array<BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceConfig>;
  /** Recurring cron schedule. Presence enables scheduled execution; null means manual-only. Includes computed timestamps (next fire times, last run) on the cron variant. */
  schedule: BetaManagedAgentsSchedule | null;
  /** Computed status of the deployment: `active` or `paused`. Archived deployments report `active` with `archived_at` set. */
  status: BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentStatus;
  /** Time the deployment was last updated. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Vault IDs supplying stored credentials for sessions created from this deployment. */
  vault_ids: Array<string>;
  /** Spend ceiling stamped onto each session created from this deployment. Absent when no budget is set. */
  budget?: BetaManagedAgentsBudgetLimit | null; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
}
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentInitialEventParams = BetaManagedAgentsUserMessageEventParams | BetaManagedAgentsUserDefineOutcomeEventParams | BetaManagedAgentsSystemMessageEventParams;

interface BetaManagedAgentsScheduleParams {
  type: "cron";
  /** 5-field POSIX cron expression: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (e.g., "0 9 * * 1-5" for weekdays at 9am). Day-of-week is 0-7 where 0 and 7 both mean Sunday. Extended cron syntax - seconds or year fields, and the special characters L, W, #, and ? - is not supported, nor are predefined shortcuts (@daily). */
  expression: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 256
  /** Required. IANA timezone identifier (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles", "UTC"). Validated against the IANA timezone database. */
  timezone: string; // minLength: 1
}

type BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentInitialEvent = BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserMessageEvent | BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserDefineOutcomeEvent | BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentSystemMessageEvent;

type BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReason = BetaManagedAgentsManualDeploymentPausedReason | BetaManagedAgentsErrorDeploymentPausedReason;

type BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceConfig = BetaManagedAgentsGitHubRepositoryResourceConfig | BetaManagedAgentsFileResourceConfig | BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResourceConfig;

interface BetaManagedAgentsSchedule {
  type: "cron";
  /** 5-field POSIX cron expression: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (e.g., "0 9 * * 1-5" for weekdays at 9am). Day-of-week is 0-7 where 0 and 7 both mean Sunday. Extended cron syntax - seconds or year fields, and the special characters L, W, #, and ? - is not supported, nor are predefined shortcuts (@daily). */
  expression: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 256
  /** IANA timezone identifier (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles", "UTC"). */
  timezone: string; // minLength: 1
  /** Time the most recent scheduled run actually started. Null until one completes; preserved after the deployment is archived. Manual runs do not update this. */
  last_run_at?: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Up to 5 timestamps of upcoming cron occurrences. Non-empty for active and paused deployments (reflects what the schedule would do if unpaused); empty once the deployment is archived (`archived_at` set). Each fire is offset by a small per-schedule jitter, so a run will actually start at or shortly after its listed time. */
  upcoming_runs_at?: Array<string>;
}

type BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentStatus =
  /** The deployment is active and can run sessions. Archived deployments also report this status; check `archived_at` to distinguish them. */
  | "active"
  /** The deployment is paused. Autonomous triggers are suppressed; manual runs are still permitted. */
  | "paused";

/** A user message sent to the session. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserMessageEvent {
  type: "user.message";
  /** Array of content blocks for the user message. */
  content: Array<BetaManagedAgentsTextBlock | BetaManagedAgentsImageBlock | BetaManagedAgentsDocumentBlock | BetaManagedAgentsRedactedBlock>;
}

/** An outcome the agent should work toward. The agent begins work on receipt. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentUserDefineOutcomeEvent {
  type: "user.define_outcome";
  /** What the agent should produce. This is the task specification. */
  description: string;
  /** How to grade the outcome. Text or file reference. */
  rubric: BetaManagedAgentsFileRubric | BetaManagedAgentsTextRubric;
  /** Eval→revision cycles before giving up. Default 3, max 20. */
  max_iterations?: number | null; // format: int32
}

/** Privileged context for the accompanying turn and all subsequent turns, appended to the session's system context as a `role: "system"` turn rather than replacing the top-level system prompt. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentSystemMessageEvent {
  type: "system.message";
  /** System content blocks to append. Text-only. */
  content: Array<BetaManagedAgentsSystemContentBlock>;
}

/** A GitHub repository mounted into each session's container. The authorization token is write-only and never returned. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsGitHubRepositoryResourceConfig {
  type: "github_repository";
  /** Github URL of the repository */
  url: string;
  /** Branch or commit to check out. Defaults to the repository's default branch. */
  checkout?: BetaManagedAgentsBranchCheckout | BetaManagedAgentsCommitCheckout | null;
  /** Mount path in the container. Defaults to `/workspace/<repo-name>`. */
  mount_path?: string | null;
}

/** A file mounted into each session's container. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsFileResourceConfig {
  type: "file";
  /** ID of a previously uploaded file. */
  file_id: string;
  /** Mount path in the container. Defaults to `/mnt/session/uploads/<file_id>`. */
  mount_path?: string | null;
}

/** A memory store attached to each session created from this deployment. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreResourceConfig {
  type: "memory_store";
  /** The memory store ID (memstore_...). Must belong to the caller's organization and workspace. */
  memory_store_id: string;
  /** Access mode for the mounted store. Defaults to `read_write`. `read_only` mounts the store as a read-only filesystem. */
  access?: "read_write" | "read_only" | null;
  /** Per-attachment guidance for the agent on how to use this store. Rendered into the memory section of the system prompt. Max 4096 chars. */
  instructions?: string | null; // beta header: agent-memory-2026-07-22 or managed-agents-2026-04-01
}

/** The caller invoked the pause endpoint on the deployment. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsManualDeploymentPausedReason {
  type: "manual";
}

/** A scheduled fire recorded a failed run whose error auto-pauses the deployment. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsErrorDeploymentPausedReason {
  type: "error";
  /** The failed run's error. */
  error: BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReasonError;
}

type BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentPausedReasonError = BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsAgentArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsVaultNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsFileNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsWorkspaceArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsOrganizationDisabledDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsSkillNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsVaultArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsUnknownDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsSelfHostedResourcesUnsupportedDeploymentPausedReasonError | BetaManagedAgentsMCPEgressBlockedDeploymentPausedReasonError;

/** The deployment's environment was archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "environment_archived_error";
}

/** The deployment's agent was archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "agent_archived_error";
}

/** The deployment's environment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "environment_not_found_error";
}

/** A vault referenced by the deployment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsVaultNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "vault_not_found_error";
}

/** A file resource referenced by the deployment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsFileNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "file_not_found_error";
}

/** A referenced resource no longer exists and its kind was not reported. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "session_resource_not_found_error";
}

/** The deployment's workspace was archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsWorkspaceArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "workspace_archived_error";
}

/** The deployment's organization is disabled. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsOrganizationDisabledDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "organization_disabled_error";
}

/** A memory store referenced by the deployment is archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "memory_store_archived_error";
}

/** A skill referenced by the deployment's agent no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSkillNotFoundDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "skill_not_found_error";
}

/** A vault referenced by the deployment is archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsVaultArchivedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "vault_archived_error";
}

/** An unrecognized error auto-paused the deployment. A fallback variant; matches a run whose `error.type` is `unknown_error`. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsUnknownDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "unknown_error";
}

/** The deployment configures resources, but its environment is self-hosted and cannot mount them. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSelfHostedResourcesUnsupportedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "self_hosted_resources_unsupported_error";
}

/** An MCP server host used by the deployment's agent is blocked by the environment's network policy. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMCPEgressBlockedDeploymentPausedReasonError {
  type: "mcp_egress_blocked_error";
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** A persistent, append-only record of a single deployment execution. Records session creation success or failure — no session lifecycle tracking. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsDeploymentRun {
  type: "deployment_run";
  /** Unique identifier for this run (`drun_...`). */
  id: string;
  /** Snapshot of the agent at fire time. Always fully resolved — deployments pin agent + version. */
  agent: BetaManagedAgentsAgentReference;
  /** Time this run record was persisted. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** ID of the deployment that produced this run. */
  deployment_id: string;
  /** Populated on creation failure. Null on success. Exactly one of `session_id` or `error` is non-null. */
  error: BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentArchivedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsAgentArchivedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentNotFoundRunError | BetaManagedAgentsVaultNotFoundRunError | BetaManagedAgentsVaultArchivedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsFileNotFoundRunError | BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreArchivedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsSkillNotFoundRunError | BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceNotFoundRunError | BetaManagedAgentsWorkspaceArchivedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsOrganizationDisabledRunError | BetaManagedAgentsSessionRateLimitedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsSessionCreationRejectedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsUnknownRunError | BetaManagedAgentsSelfHostedResourcesUnsupportedRunError | BetaManagedAgentsMCPEgressBlockedRunError | null;
  /** Populated on success. Null on creation failure. Exactly one of `session_id` or `error` is non-null. */
  session_id: string | null;
  /** What triggered this run and trigger-specific metadata. */
  trigger_context: BetaManagedAgentsTriggerContext;
}
```

/** The deployment's agent was archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAgentArchivedRunError {
  type: "agent_archived_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** The deployment's environment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsEnvironmentNotFoundRunError {
  type: "environment_not_found_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A vault referenced by the deployment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsVaultNotFoundRunError {
  type: "vault_not_found_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A vault referenced by the deployment is archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsVaultArchivedRunError {
  type: "vault_archived_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A file resource referenced by the deployment no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsFileNotFoundRunError {
  type: "file_not_found_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A memory store referenced by the deployment is archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMemoryStoreArchivedRunError {
  type: "memory_store_archived_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A skill referenced by the deployment's agent no longer exists. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSkillNotFoundRunError {
  type: "skill_not_found_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** A referenced resource no longer exists and its kind was not reported. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionResourceNotFoundRunError {
  type: "session_resource_not_found_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** The deployment's workspace was archived. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsWorkspaceArchivedRunError {
  type: "workspace_archived_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** The deployment's organization is disabled. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsOrganizationDisabledRunError {
  type: "organization_disabled_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** Session creation was rejected due to rate limiting. The schedule keeps firing; subsequent runs may succeed. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionRateLimitedRunError {
  type: "session_rate_limited_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** The session create request was rejected with a non-retryable validation error. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionCreationRejectedRunError {
  type: "session_creation_rejected_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** An unknown or unexpected error caused the run to fail. A fallback variant; clients that do not recognize a new error type can match on message alone. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsUnknownRunError {
  type: "unknown_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** The deployment configures resources, but its environment is self-hosted and cannot mount them. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSelfHostedResourcesUnsupportedRunError {
  type: "self_hosted_resources_unsupported_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

/** An MCP server host used by the deployment's agent is blocked by the environment's network policy. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMCPEgressBlockedRunError {
  type: "mcp_egress_blocked_error";
  /** Human-readable error description. */
  message: string;
}

type BetaManagedAgentsTriggerContext = BetaManagedAgentsScheduleTriggerContext | BetaManagedAgentsManualTriggerContext;

/** The run was fired by the deployment's cron schedule. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsScheduleTriggerContext {
  type: "schedule";
  /** The UTC instant at which the cron expression matched in the configured timezone, before jitter is applied. At most one run is recorded per (`deployment_id`, `scheduled_at`) pair. */
  scheduled_at: string; // format: date-time
}

/** The run was started manually by creating a session directly against the deployment. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsManualTriggerContext {
  type: "manual";
}
```

```ts
/** Result of live-probing a credential against its configured MCP server. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsCredentialValidation {
  type: "vault_credential_validation";
  /** Unique identifier of the credential that was validated. */
  credential_id: string;
  /** Whether the credential has a refresh token configured. */
  has_refresh_token: boolean;
  /** Details of the MCP probe step that failed, or `null` if the probe succeeded or there was no access token to test. */
  mcp_probe: BetaManagedAgentsMCPProbe | null;
  /** Details of the refresh-token exchange attempted on a 401. Null when no refresh was attempted. */
  refresh: BetaManagedAgentsRefreshObject | null;
  /** Overall verdict of the validation probe. */
  status: BetaManagedAgentsCredentialValidationStatus;
  /** When the validation probe was performed. */
  validated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Identifier of the vault containing the credential. */
  vault_id: string;
}
```

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaManagedAgentsMCPProbe {
  /** The HTTP error response from the MCP server, or `null` if the MCP server didn't return one for the failing step, for example after a timeout or a DNS or TLS failure. */
  http_response: BetaManagedAgentsRefreshHTTPResponse | null;
  /** The MCP method that failed (for example `initialize` or `tools/list`). */
  method: string;
}

interface BetaManagedAgentsRefreshObject {
  /** The captured HTTP error response from the token endpoint. Populated only when `status` is `failed`. */
  http_response: BetaManagedAgentsRefreshHTTPResponse | null;
  /**
   * Outcome of the refresh attempt.
   * - `"succeeded"`: The token endpoint returned a new access token.
   * - `"failed"`: The token endpoint returned an error response. See `http_response` for detail.
   * - `"connect_error"`: The token endpoint could not be reached (DNS, TLS, or connection error).
   * - `"no_refresh_token"`: No refresh token is stored for the credential, so no exchange was attempted.
   */
  status: "succeeded" | "failed" | "connect_error" | "no_refresh_token";
}

type BetaManagedAgentsCredentialValidationStatus =
  /** The credential successfully authenticated against its MCP server. */
  | "valid"
  /** The probe reached the MCP server and the server rejected the credential, or no access token is stored. A refresh, if one was tried, didn't recover it. Usually the end user needs to authorize again. */
  | "invalid"
  /** The probe couldn't tell whether the credential works, for example because of a network error or because a refresh succeeded but the new access token wasn't tested. Validate the credential again to find out. */
  | "unknown";

interface BetaManagedAgentsRefreshHTTPResponse {
  /** Response body. May be truncated and has sensitive values scrubbed. */
  body: string;
  /** Whether `body` was truncated. */
  body_truncated: boolean;
  /** Value of the `Content-Type` response header. */
  content_type: string;
  /** HTTP status code. */
  status_code: number; // format: int32
}
```

```ts
/** One entry in a memory's history, recording a single change and who made it. Every change to a memory adds one version. Only redaction can change a version after that. Versions belong to the memory store and stay after the memory is deleted. Each version is retained for at least the version retention period after it was written, unless the store itself is deleted. Retrieving a redacted version succeeds, with `content`, `path`, `content_size_bytes`, and `content_sha256` set to `null`. Check `redacted_at` to find out whether a version was redacted. See the [memory guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/memory?sdk_languages=typescript#audit-memory-changes) to learn more about memory versions. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsMemoryVersion {
  type: "memory_version";
  /** Unique identifier for this version (a `memver_...` value). */
  id: string;
  /** When this version was written, in RFC 3339 format. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** The ID of the memory that this version belongs to (`mem_...`). The ID stays valid after the memory is deleted.   memory_id: string;
  /** ID of the memory store this version belongs to (a `memstore_...` value). */
  memory_store_id: string;
  /** The kind of mutation this version records: `created`, `modified`, or `deleted`. */
  operation: BetaManagedAgentsMemoryVersionOperation;
  /** The memory's UTF-8 text content as of this version. `null` when `view=basic`, when `operation` is `deleted`, or when `redacted_at` is set. */
  content?: string | null;
  /** Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of `content` as of this version (64 characters). `null` when `redacted_at` is set or `operation` is `deleted`. Populated regardless of `view` otherwise. */
  content_sha256?: string | null;
  /** Size of `content` in bytes as of this version. `null` when `redacted_at` is set or `operation` is `deleted`. Populated regardless of `view` otherwise. */
  content_size_bytes?: number | null; // format: int32
  /** Who made this change to the memory, or `null` if the author wasn't recorded. Redacting the version doesn't change this field. A `session_actor` here is an agent that wrote through the store's mounted filesystem at `/mnt/memory/`. The version doesn't record the API key that created that session. So the author in `created_by` is who made the change, not who is ultimately responsible for it. You can [retrieve the session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/retrieve?sdk_languages=typescript) to learn more about where the change came from. */
  created_by?: BetaManagedAgentsActor;
  /** The memory's path at the time of this write. `null` if and only if `redacted_at` is set. */
  path?: string | null;
  /** When the version was redacted, in RFC 3339, or `null` if it hasn't been. When set, `content`, `path`, `content_size_bytes`, and `content_sha256` are `null`.   redacted_at?: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Who redacted this version, or `null` if it has not been redacted. In practice always an `api_actor`, `user_actor`, or `service_account_actor` (agents do not have a redact capability). */
  redacted_by?: BetaManagedAgentsActor;
}
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaManagedAgentsMemoryVersionOperation =
  /** The memory was created. The first version in any memory's lineage. */
  | "created"
  /** The memory's `content`, `path`, or both were changed via update. Writes the agent makes through the filesystem mount also appear as `modified`. */
  | "modified"
  /** The memory was deleted. The `content`, `content_size_bytes`, and `content_sha256` fields are `null` on this version. The preceding version, while it is retained, records the deleted content's size and hash. */
  | "deleted";

type BetaManagedAgentsActor = BetaManagedAgentsSessionActor | BetaManagedAgentsAPIActor | BetaManagedAgentsUserActor | BetaManagedAgentsServiceAccountActor;

/** An agent acting during a session, for example through the session's mounted filesystem. It names the session itself, not the user or API key that started the session. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsSessionActor {
  type: "session_actor";
  /** ID of the session (a `sesn_...` value). Look up the session via [Retrieve a session](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/sessions/retrieve?sdk_languages=typescript) for further provenance. */
  session_id: string; // minLength: 1
}

/** A direct caller of the public API, identified by the API key that authenticated the request. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsAPIActor {
  type: "api_actor";
  /** ID of the API key (an `apikey_...` value). This identifies the key, not the secret. */
  api_key_id: string; // minLength: 1
}

/** A human user, for example acting through the Anthropic Console. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsUserActor {
  type: "user_actor";
  /** ID of the user (a `user_...` value). */
  user_id: string; // minLength: 1
}

/** A workload authenticated as a service account, for example via Workload Identity Federation. */
interface BetaManagedAgentsServiceAccountActor {
  type: "service_account_actor";
  /** ID of the service account (a `svac_...` value). */
  service_account_id: string; // minLength: 1
}
```

#### Example request

```ts
import fs from "fs";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

});

console.log(betaFileMetadata.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "file_011CNha8iCJcU1wXNR6q4V8w",
  "created_at": "2025-04-15T18:37:24.100435Z",
  "filename": "document.pdf",
  "mime_type": "application/pdf",
  "size_bytes": 102400,
  "type": "file",
  "downloadable": false,
  "expires_at": "2025-05-15T18:37:24.100435Z",
  "scope": {
    "id": "id",
    "type": "session"
  }
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface FileUploadParams {
  /** The file to upload. Only the final path component of the part's `filename` is kept; an absent or empty `filename` is replaced with `unnamed` plus the extension for the file's stored `mime_type`, when known. */
  file: Uploadable; // format: binary
  /** Seconds from upload until the file expires and its bytes become permanently unavailable. Must be between 3600 (one hour) and 7776000 (ninety days). */
  expires_in_seconds?: number; // minimum: 3600, maximum: 7776000
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaFileMetadata {
  /** Object type. For files, this is always `"file"`. */
  type: "file";
  /** Unique object identifier. The format and length of IDs may change over time. */
  id: string;
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string representing when the file was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Original filename of the uploaded file. */
  filename: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 500
  /** MIME type of the file. */
  mime_type: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Size of the file in bytes. */
  size_bytes: number; // minimum: 0
  /** Whether the file can be downloaded. */
  downloadable?: boolean; // default: false
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string representing when the file will expire and become unavailable for download. Null if the file does not expire. For files uploaded with `expires_in_seconds`, this is the upload time plus that value. */
  expires_at?: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** The scope of this file, indicating the context in which it was created (e.g., a session). */
  scope?: BetaFileScope | null;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `ClaudeCodeKeyCreatorNotMemberError` (HTTP status 400, error code `claude_code_key_creator_not_member`)

  The API key belongs to the Claude Code workspace, and the user who created it is no longer a member of the organization or of that workspace.

- `CMEKKeyDisabledError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_disabled`)

  The workspace's customer-managed encryption key is disabled or revoked. Re-enable the key, then retry.

- `CMEKKeyNetworkBlockedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_network_blocked`)

  The key management service's network access controls blocked the request to the workspace's customer-managed encryption key. The key itself may be healthy.

- `OrganizationOnHoldError` (HTTP status 400, error code `organization_on_hold`)

  Anthropic has disabled the organization for trust and safety reasons. An organization disabled for any other reason, such as billing, does not get this code. `appeal_url`, when present, is where the organization can appeal.

- `StorageQuotaExceededError` (HTTP status 400, error code `storage_quota_exceeded`)

  The organization's file storage quota is exhausted. Delete files to free up space, then retry the upload.

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaFileScope {
  /** The type of scope (e.g., `"session"`). */
  type: "session";
  /** The ID of the scoping resource (e.g., the session ID). */
  id: string;
}
```

## Beta › Webhooks

### Unwrap

- Signature: `client.beta.webhooks.unwrap(body: string, options: { headers: Record<string, string>; key?: string }): BetaWebhookEvent`

Verifies the webhook signature from the `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature`
headers using your webhook signing key, then parses the payload into an event. Fails if the
signature is missing or invalid.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Replace these with the raw body and the HTTP headers of the incoming webhook request.
const body =
  '{"type":"event","id":"whe_0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0","created_at":"2026-03-15T10:00:00Z","data":{"type":"session.status_idled"}}';
const headers = {
  "webhook-id": "msg_0123456789",
  "webhook-timestamp": "1773568800",
  "webhook-signature": "v1,ZmFrZS1zaWduYXR1cmU="
};
const event = client.beta.webhooks.unwrap(body, { headers });

console.log(event);
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** The body of the incoming webhook request, exactly as received: the signature is computed over these bytes. */
body: string;

/**
 * - `headers: Record<string, string>`: The HTTP headers of the incoming webhook request. Verification reads `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature`.
 * - `key?: string`: The webhook signing key. Defaults to the client's `webhookKey` option.
 */
options: { headers: Record<string, string>; key?: string };
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaWebhookEvent {
  /** Object type. Always `event` for webhook payloads. */
  type: "event";
  /** Unique event identifier for idempotency. */
  id: string;
  /** RFC 3339 timestamp when the event occurred. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  data: BetaWebhookEventData;
}
```

### Parse Unverified

- Signature: `client.beta.webhooks.parseUnverified(body: string): BetaWebhookEvent`

Parses a webhook payload into an event without verifying its signature. Prefer `unwrap()` unless
you have already verified the signature yourself.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Replace this with the raw body of the incoming webhook request.
const body =
  '{"type":"event","id":"whe_0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0","created_at":"2026-03-15T10:00:00Z","data":{"type":"session.status_idled"}}';
const event = client.beta.webhooks.parseUnverified(body);

console.log(event);
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** The raw JSON body of the incoming webhook request. */
body: string;
```

```ts
interface UserProfileCreateParams {
  /**
   * How the platform uses the API for this entity. `application` (default): the profile represents an individual end-user of the platform's product. `passthrough`: the profile identifies a company the platform resells Claude access to.
   * - `"application"`: The user profile represents an individual end-user of a product that the platform builds on the API. New profiles get this value by default.
   * - `"passthrough"`: The user profile represents a company that the platform resells Claude access to.
   */
  access_type?: "application" | "passthrough";
  /** Platform's own identifier for this user. Not enforced unique. Maximum 255 characters. Legacy field, accepted only under the `user-profiles-2026-03-24` and `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta headers; without one of them, send `external_user_details.reference_id`. */
  external_id?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255, beta header: user-profiles-2026-03-24 or user-profiles-2026-08-18
  /** Details about the entity this profile represents, as the platform states them. Every field is optional. Not accepted under the legacy `user-profiles-2026-03-24` and `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta headers, which take the top-level `external_id` (and, under `user-profiles-2026-08-18`, `external_user_onboarded_at`) instead. */
  external_user_details?: BetaUserProfileExternalUserDetailsParams;
  /** When the entity this profile represents opened its account with the platform, in RFC 3339 format: for an `application` profile, when the end-user signed up; for a `passthrough` profile, when the company became the platform's customer. Must be a complete timestamp no more than 1 minute in the future. Optional. Legacy field, accepted only under the `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta header; without a legacy header, send `external_user_details.onboarded_at`. */
  external_user_onboarded_at?: string; // format: date-time, beta header: user-profiles-2026-08-18
  /** Free-form key-value data to attach to this user profile. Maximum 16 keys, with keys up to 64 characters and values up to 512 characters. Values must be non-empty strings. */
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Optional for all profiles. Real-world name of the entity this profile represents (company or individual); for a company the platform resells Claude access to (`access_type` `passthrough`), that company's name where known. Maximum 255 characters. */
  name?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** A record of an entity that the platform serves through the API, such as an end-user of the platform's product or a company that the platform resells Claude access to. A Messages, Message Batches or token counting request can send a profile's `id` in the `anthropic-user-profile-id` header to attribute the request to that entity. */
interface BetaUserProfile {
  /** Object type. Always `user_profile`. */
  type: "user_profile";
  /** Unique identifier for this user profile, prefixed `uprof_`. */
  id: string;
  /** When this user profile was created, in RFC 3339 format. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Arbitrary key-value metadata. Maximum 16 pairs, keys up to 64 chars, values up to 512 chars. */
  metadata: Record<string, string>;
  /** Real-world name of the entity this profile represents (company or individual). For a company the platform resells Claude access to (`access_type` `passthrough`) this is that company's name. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  name: string | null;
  /** Trust grants for this profile, keyed by grant name. Key omitted when no grant is active or in flight. */
  trust_grants: Record<string, BetaUserProfileTrustGrant>; // beta header: user-profiles-2026-03-24 or user-profiles-2026-08-18 or user-profiles-2026-09-04
  /** When this user profile was last modified, in RFC 3339 format. It normally also updates shortly after Anthropic gives the profile an approval or withdraws one. Other changes to the statuses that Anthropic reports do not always update it, so read the status itself rather than watching this timestamp. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /**
   * How the platform uses the API for this entity: `application` (default) or `passthrough`. Absent under the legacy `user-profiles-2026-03-24` beta header.
   * - `"application"`: The user profile represents an individual end-user of a product that the platform builds on the API. New profiles get this value by default.
   * - `"passthrough"`: The user profile represents a company that the platform resells Claude access to.
   */
  access_type?: "application" | "passthrough";
  /** Platform's own identifier for this user. Not enforced unique. Legacy field, present only under the `user-profiles-2026-03-24` and `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta headers; without one of them, the value is `external_user_details.reference_id`. */
  external_id?: string | null; // beta header: user-profiles-2026-03-24 or user-profiles-2026-08-18
  /** Details about the entity this profile represents, as the platform states them; not verified by Anthropic. Every field is present, `null` until the platform supplies a value. Absent under the legacy `user-profiles-2026-03-24` and `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta headers, which serve `reference_id` as the top-level `external_id` and, under `user-profiles-2026-08-18`, `onboarded_at` as `external_user_onboarded_at`. */
  external_user_details?: BetaUserProfileExternalUserDetails;
  /** When the entity this profile represents opened its account with the platform, as stated by the platform, in RFC 3339 format (UTC). `null` until the platform supplies one. Legacy field, present only under the `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta header; without a legacy header, the value is `external_user_details.onboarded_at`. */
  external_user_onboarded_at?: string | null; // format: date-time, beta header: user-profiles-2026-08-18
}
```

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaUserProfileExternalUserDetailsParams {
  /**
   * The status of the entity's account on the platform: `active`, `suspended` or `blocked`.
   * - `"active"`: The platform has neither restricted nor barred the account of the entity that the user profile represents.
   * - `"suspended"`: The platform has restricted the account of the entity that the user profile represents and may restore it.
   * - `"blocked"`: The platform has barred the account of the entity that the user profile represents.
   */
  account_status?: "active" | "suspended" | "blocked" | null;
  /** The country of the entity (not of the platform), as the platform determines it: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in upper case, for example `US`. Only the form, two uppercase ASCII letters, is checked. */
  country?: string | null; // pattern: ^[A-Z]{2}$
  /** A hash of the entity's email address, computed by the platform. Anthropic treats it as an opaque string and does not prescribe the hash function. 1 to 255 characters. */
  email_hash?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** What kind of entity the profile represents: `individual`, `business`, `non_profit` or `government`. */
  entity_type?: "individual" | "business" | "non_profit" | "government" | null;
  /** A hash of the entity's name, computed by the platform. Anthropic treats it as an opaque string and does not prescribe the hash function. 1 to 255 characters. */
  name_hash?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** When the entity opened its account with the platform, in RFC 3339 format: for an `application` profile, when the end-user signed up; for a `passthrough` profile, when the company became the platform's customer. Must be a complete timestamp no more than 1 minute in the future. */
  onboarded_at?: string; // format: date-time
  /** The platform's own reference for the entity, for example the key of the end-user's row in the platform's database. Not interpreted by Anthropic and not enforced unique. 1 to 255 characters. */
  reference_id?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
}

interface BetaUserProfileTrustGrant {
  /** Status of the trust grant. */
  status: "active" | "pending" | "rejected";
}

interface BetaUserProfileExternalUserDetails {
  /**
   * The status of the entity's account on the platform: `active`, `suspended` or `blocked`. `null` until the platform supplies one.
   * - `"active"`: The platform has neither restricted nor barred the account of the entity that the user profile represents.
   * - `"suspended"`: The platform has restricted the account of the entity that the user profile represents and may restore it.
   * - `"blocked"`: The platform has barred the account of the entity that the user profile represents.
   */
  account_status: "active" | "suspended" | "blocked" | null;
  /** The country the platform associates with the entity, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  country: string | null;
  /** The platform-computed hash of the entity's email address. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  email_hash: string | null;
  /** What kind of entity the profile represents: `individual`, `business`, `non_profit` or `government`. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  entity_type: "individual" | "business" | "non_profit" | "government" | null;
  /** The platform-computed hash of the entity's name. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  name_hash: string | null;
  /** When the entity opened its account with the platform, as stated by the platform, in RFC 3339 format (UTC). `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  onboarded_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** The platform's own reference for the entity. `null` until the platform supplies one. */
  reference_id: string | null;
}

Once set, a value cannot be cleared and `null` is rejected. Not accepted under the legacy `user-profiles-2026-03-24` and `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta headers. */

Must be a complete RFC 3339 timestamp no more than 1 minute in the future. Legacy field, accepted only under the `user-profiles-2026-08-18` beta header; without a legacy header, send `external_user_details.onboarded_at`. */

  metadata?: Record<string, string>;

  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */

}
