## Beta › Dreams

### Create a Dream

- Signature: `client.beta.dreams.create(params: DreamCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaDream`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/dreams`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: dreaming-2026-04-21`

Start an asynchronous job that uses past sessions to produce a reorganized version of a memory store and get back the dream to poll for the result.

By default the dream writes its result to a new memory store and doesn't change the input memory store. The response has `status` set to `pending` and an empty `outputs` array. Poll the dream until `status` is `completed`, `failed`, or `canceled`.

See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#create-a-dream) to learn more about creating dreams.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaDream = await client.beta.dreams.create({
  inputs: [{ memory_store_id: "x", type: "memory_store" }],
  model: "string"
});

console.log(betaDream.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "id",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "ended_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "error": {
    "message": "message",
    "type": "type"
  },
  "inputs": [
    {
      "memory_store_id": "x",
      "type": "memory_store"
    }
  ],
  "instructions": "instructions",
  "model": {
    "id": "x",
    "speed": "standard"
  },
  "output_behavior": {
    "type": "create_new"
  },
  "outputs": [
    {
      "memory_store_id": "memory_store_id",
      "type": "memory_store"
    }
  ],
  "session_id": "session_id",
  "status": "pending",
  "type": "dream",
  "usage": {
    "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0,
    "cache_read_input_tokens": 0,
    "input_tokens": 0,
    "output_tokens": 0
  }
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface DreamCreateParams {
  /** The memory store and sessions for the dream to read, as exactly one `memory_store` entry and exactly one `sessions` entry. */
  inputs: Array<BetaDreamInput>;
  /** The model that runs a dream, given as a model ID or as an object with `id` and `speed`. In the object form, `speed` can only be `standard`. The [Availability section of the Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#feature-availability) lists the supported models. */
  model: string | BetaDreamModelConfigParam;
  /** Guidance that steers how the dream reads the sessions and organizes the output memory store, from 1 to 4,096 characters. See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#steer-with-instructions) for what kinds of instructions work well. */
  instructions?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 4096
  /** Which memory store a dream writes its result to. Defaults to `create_new` when left out of a create request. */
  output_behavior?: BetaOutputBehavior;
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `dreaming-2026-04-21` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** An asynchronous job that reads a memory store and past sessions, then writes a reorganized version of that memory store. By default the dream writes its result to a new memory store and doesn't change the input memory store. With `output_behavior` set to `update_existing`, it writes its result into the input memory store instead. The Dreams API is in research preview: the request and response shapes are volatile and may change without the deprecation period that applies to stable endpoints. See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#how-it-works) for what a dream reads and produces. */
interface BetaDream {
  type: "dream";
  /** The unique ID of the dream (`drm_...`). */
  id: string;
  /** When the dream was archived, in RFC 3339, or `null` if it hasn't been archived. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** When the dream was created, in RFC 3339. Lists of dreams are sorted by this time, newest first. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** When the dream reached `completed`, `failed`, or `canceled`, in RFC 3339, or `null` if it is still `pending` or `running`. */
  ended_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Why the dream failed, or `null` if `status` isn't `failed`. */
  error: BetaDreamError | null;
  /** The sources that the dream reads, from the request that created it. */
  inputs: Array<BetaDreamInput>;
  /** The guidance given when the dream was created, or `null` if none was given. */
  instructions: string | null;
  /** The model that runs a dream, from the request that created it. The dream uses this model for all of its work. The response always gives the model as an object, even if the request gave only a model ID. */
  model: BetaDreamModelConfig;
  /** Where the dream writes its result, as set in the request that created the dream. If that request left out `output_behavior`, the dream used the `create_new` behavior. */
  output_behavior: BetaOutputBehavior;
  /** The memory store that holds the dream's result, as a one-item array, or an empty array until the dream records that memory store. The array is empty while the dream is `pending` and for a short time after it starts `running`. It can stay empty if the dream fails or is canceled before then. The memory store holds the complete result only once `status` is `completed`. See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#use-the-output) for how to review and use the result. */
  outputs: Array<BetaDreamOutput>;
  /** The ID of the session that runs the dream (`sesn_...`), or `null` if that session hasn't started. Stream that session's events to follow what the dream reads and writes. See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#watch-the-pipeline-run) for how to watch a running dream. */
  session_id: string | null;
  /** Where a dream is in its lifecycle. `completed`, `failed`, and `canceled` are final: once a dream has one of these statuses, its status doesn't change again. See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#lifecycle) for what each status means. */
  status: BetaDreamStatus;
  /** The dream's token counts, which stop changing once its `status` is `completed` or `failed`. After a cancel, they can keep changing. */
  usage: BetaDreamUsage;
}
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaDreamInput = BetaDreamMemoryStoreInput | BetaDreamSessionsInput;

/** The object form of `model` in a request to create a dream. */
interface BetaDreamModelConfigParam {
  /** The ID of the model to run the dream with. The ID can be 1 to 256 characters long. The [Availability section of the Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#feature-availability) lists the supported models. */
  id: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 256
  /** How fast the model generates output for the dream. Defaults to `standard`. Dreams accept only `standard`. */
  speed?: "standard" | "fast" | null;
}

type BetaOutputBehavior = BetaOutputBehaviorCreateNew | BetaOutputBehaviorUpdateExisting;

interface BetaDreamError {
  /** A code for why the dream failed, such as `timeout` or `internal_error`. The [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#errors) lists common error codes and when they occur. */
  type: string;
  /** A human-readable explanation of why the dream failed. */
  message: string;
}

interface BetaDreamModelConfig {
  /** The ID of the model that runs the dream, as given in the request that created it. */
  id: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 256
  /** How fast the model generates output for the dream. Always `standard`. */
  speed?: "standard" | "fast"; // beta header: managed-agents-2026-04-01
}

interface BetaDreamOutput {
  type: "memory_store";
  /** The ID of the memory store that the dream writes its result to (`memstore_...`). With `output_behavior` set to `create_new`, this is a new memory store. With `update_existing`, it is the input memory store. */
  memory_store_id: string;
}

type BetaDreamStatus =
  /** The dream is waiting to start and hasn't read its inputs yet. `outputs` is empty and every `usage` count is zero. */
  | "pending"
  /** The dream is reading its inputs and writing its result. `usage` updates while the dream has this status. */
  | "running"
  /** The dream finished and its output memory store holds the complete result. */
  | "completed"
  /** The dream stopped with an error, which `error` describes. If `outputs` references a memory store, that memory store keeps what the dream wrote before it stopped. */
  | "failed"
  /** A cancel request stopped the dream before it reached `completed` or `failed`. If `outputs` references a memory store, that memory store keeps what the dream wrote. `usage` can keep changing after the cancel. */
  | "canceled";

interface BetaDreamUsage {
  /** The dream's input tokens that were written to the prompt cache, for both the 5-minute and 1-hour cache durations. */
  cache_creation_input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** The dream's input tokens that were read from the prompt cache. */
  cache_read_input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** The dream's input tokens that weren't read from or written to the prompt cache. */
  input_tokens: number; // format: int32
  /** The tokens that the model generated for the dream. */
  output_tokens: number; // format: int32
}

/** Write the result to a new memory store that starts as a copy of the input memory store. This is the default. The new memory store is in the same workspace as the dream. The dream doesn't change the input memory store. */
interface BetaOutputBehaviorCreateNew {
  type: "create_new";
}

/** Write the result into the input memory store instead of a new memory store. The credential must be allowed to write memory stores, or the request returns a 403 error. While another `update_existing` dream on the same memory store hasn't fully stopped, the request returns a 409 error. */
interface BetaOutputBehaviorUpdateExisting {
  type: "update_existing";
  /** The ID of the memory store for the dream to write its result to (`memstore_...`). It must be the memory store in the `memory_store` entry of `inputs`. */
  memory_store_id: string; // minLength: 1
}

/** The memory store that a dream reads, given as an entry in `inputs`. With `output_behavior` set to `update_existing`, the dream writes its result into this memory store. Otherwise the dream doesn't change it. */
interface BetaDreamMemoryStoreInput {
  type: "memory_store";
  /** The ID of the memory store for the dream to read (`memstore_...`). The memory store must be in the same workspace as the dream and must not be archived. */
  memory_store_id: string; // minLength: 1
}

/** The sessions that a dream reads, given as an entry in `inputs`. */
interface BetaDreamSessionsInput {
  type: "sessions";
  /** The IDs of the sessions whose transcripts the dream reads (`sesn_...`). Give 1 to 100 IDs, with no duplicates. Each session must be in the same workspace as the dream. Responses list the IDs in sorted order. */
  session_ids: Array<string>;
}
```

### List Dreams

- Signature: `client.beta.dreams.list(params?: DreamListParams, options?: RequestOptions): PageCursor<BetaDream>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/dreams`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: dreaming-2026-04-21`

List the dreams in the workspace, newest first.

Archived dreams are left out unless `include_archived` is `true`.

See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#list-dreams) for how to page through dreams.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaDream of client.beta.dreams.list()) {
  console.log(betaDream.id);
}
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "id",

      "ended_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",

        "message": "message",
        "type": "type"

        "speed": "standard"
      },
      "output_behavior": {

      },

          "type": "memory_store"
        }

        "cache_creation_input_tokens": 0,

      }
    }
  ],
  "next_page": "next_page"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface DreamListParams {
  /** Return only dreams created after this time (exclusive), in RFC 3339. */
  "created_at[gt]"?: string; // query parameter, format: date-time
  /** Return only dreams created before this time (exclusive), in RFC 3339. */

  statuses?: Array<BetaDreamStatus>; // query parameter

  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

### Cancel a Dream

- Signature: `client.beta.dreams.cancel(dreamID: string, params?: DreamCancelParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaDream`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/dreams/{dream_id}/cancel`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: dreaming-2026-04-21`

Stop a `pending` or `running` dream.

The response shows `status` as `canceled`, unless the dream reached `completed` or `failed` first. `usage` can keep changing after the response. Canceling a `canceled` dream returns it unchanged. Canceling a `completed` or `failed` dream returns a 400 error.

See the [Dreams guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams?sdk_languages=typescript#cancel-a-dream) to learn more about canceling dreams.

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaDream = await client.beta.dreams.cancel("dream_id");

console.log(betaDream.id);
```

### Archive a Dream

- Signature: `client.beta.dreams.archive(dreamID: string, params?: DreamArchiveParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaDream`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/dreams/{dream_id}/archive`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: dreaming-2026-04-21`

### Create Tunnel

- Endpoint: `POST /v1/tunnels`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22`

The Tunnels API is in research preview. It requires the `anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` header and may change without a deprecation period. It supersedes the Admin API endpoints at `/v1/organizations/tunnels`, which remain available during a migration window.

Creates a tunnel. Creation allocates a fresh hostname and provisions the tunnel; it is not idempotent. The new tunnel rejects MCP traffic until at least one CA certificate is added.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaTunnel = await client.beta.tunnels.create({});

console.log(betaTunnel.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "id",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "display_name": "display_name",
  "domain": "domain",
  "type": "tunnel"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface TunnelCreateParams {
  /** Optional human-readable name for the tunnel (1-255 characters). */
  display_name?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter

Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts

interface BetaTunnel {
  type: "tunnel";
  /** Unique identifier for the tunnel, prefixed with `tnl_`. */

  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the tunnel was archived. Null if it is not archived. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time

  domain: string;
}
```

Registers a public CA certificate on a tunnel. Anthropic verifies the gateway's server certificate against this CA when it terminates the inner TLS session. A tunnel holds at most two non-archived certificates.

#### Example request

```ts

  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

  ca_certificate_pem: "ca_certificate_pem"
});

console.log(betaTunnelCertificate.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "id",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "expires_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "fingerprint": "fingerprint",
  "tunnel_id": "tunnel_id",
  "type": "tunnel_certificate"
}
```

```ts
interface CertificateCreateParams {
  /** PEM-encoded X.509 CA certificate. Must contain exactly one certificate and no private-key material. Maximum 8KB. */
  ca_certificate_pem: string; // maxLength: 8192
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** A CA certificate attached to a tunnel. */
interface BetaTunnelCertificate {
  type: "tunnel_certificate";
  /** Unique identifier for the certificate, prefixed with `tcrt_`. */

  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was archived. Null if it is still in the trusted set. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the certificate was registered. */

  /** ID of the tunnel the certificate is registered against. */
  tunnel_id: string;
}
```

```ts
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

### Archive Tunnel Certificate

- Signature: `client.beta.tunnels.certificates.archive(certificateID: string, params: CertificateArchiveParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaTunnelCertificate`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/tunnels/{tunnel_id}/certificates/{certificate_id}/archive`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22`

The Tunnels API is in research preview. It requires the `anthropic-beta: mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` header and may change without a deprecation period. It supersedes the Admin API endpoints at `/v1/organizations/tunnels`, which remain available during a migration window.

Archives a tunnel certificate, removing it from the set Anthropic trusts for the tunnel. The certificate record is retained. Archiving the last non-archived certificate is permitted; the tunnel rejects MCP traffic until a new certificate is added.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaTunnelCertificate = await client.beta.tunnels.certificates.archive(
  "certificate_id",
  { tunnel_id: "tunnel_id" }
);

console.log(betaTunnelCertificate.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "id",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "expires_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "fingerprint": "fingerprint",
  "tunnel_id": "tunnel_id",
  "type": "tunnel_certificate"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the certificate to archive (`tcrt_...`). */
certificateID: string; // path parameter

interface CertificateArchiveParams {
  /** ID of the tunnel (`tnl_...`). */
  tunnel_id: string; // path parameter
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `mcp-tunnels-2026-06-22` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
  /** Optional header to select the Workspace for this request. The value is a Workspace ID (for example, `wrkspc_011CZkZaBF1tNoB5wlCeusgy`). Only needed for credentials that can act on more than one Workspace. A credential that belongs to a specific Workspace may omit it; if sent, it must match that Workspace. */
  workspace_id?: string; // header parameter
}
```

- `WorkspaceAPIKeyLimitExceededError` (HTTP status 400, error code `workspace_api_key_limit_exceeded`)

```ts
interface ExternalKeyCreateParams {
  /** KMS provider identity and auth coordinates. */
  provider_config: BetaAWSExternalKeyConfig | BetaGCPExternalKeyConfig | BetaAzureExternalKeyConfigParam;
  /** Human-friendly display name. */
  display_name?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Data residency geo. Only `us` is supported. */
  geo?: "us";
  /** ID of a user profile to bind the key to. A user profile represents one of your customers: bind a customer's key to that customer's user profile. A key bound to a user profile can only be attached to a Workspace that has the same user profile, and the binding cannot be changed later. Omit this field only for your organization's own key, because a key created without a user profile ID can be attached to any Workspace, including another customer's. */
  user_profile_id?: string | null;
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** CMEK external key config belonging to the caller's organization. Configs are organization-scoped. Workspaces attach to a config; once any workspace references it, the provider fields become effectively immutable (existing encrypted data needs the config for decrypt). */
interface BetaExternalKey {
  type: "external_key";
  /** Identifier of the external key config: a tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or, on Claude Platform on AWS, an AWS KMS key's ARN. */
  id: string;
  /** Whether any workspace uses this config to encrypt its data — counting live and archived workspaces (an archived workspace's data remains encrypted under the config), excluding deleted ones. Only an attached config is used by the encryption path; an `unattached` config is inert and can be deleted. */
  attachment: BetaExternalKeyAttachedAttachment | BetaExternalKeyUnattachedAttachment;
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Human-friendly display name. Null if none was set. */
  display_name: string | null;
  /** Data residency geo. Selects the region this key is used in. */
  geo: string;
  /** KMS provider identity and auth coordinates. */
  provider_config: BetaAWSExternalKeyConfig | BetaGCPExternalKeyConfig | BetaAzureExternalKeyConfig;
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** ID of the user profile the key is bound to, or null if the key is not bound to one. A key bound to a user profile can only be attached to a Workspace that has the same user profile. A key that isn't bound can be attached to a Workspace whatever its user profile. */
  user_profile_id: string | null;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `UserProfileNotFoundError` (HTTP status 400, error code `user_profile_not_found`)

  The request depends on a user profile that does not exist in the organization or is no longer active. The request either names this user profile by ID, or names a resource, such as an External Key, that is bound to it.

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaAWSExternalKeyConfig {
  type: "aws";
  /** Full ARN of the AWS KMS key. On Claude Platform on AWS, alias ARNs are rejected, and your organization's own key must be a single-Region key in your organization's AWS account. */
  kms_arn: string; // maxLength: 2048
  /** AWS region. Derived from `kms_arn` if omitted. */
  region?: string | null;
  /**
   * IAM role ARN. Deprecated; this field is ignored.
   * @deprecated
   */
  role_arn?: string | null;
}

interface BetaGCPExternalKeyConfig {
  type: "gcp";
  /** Full resource name of the Cloud KMS key. */
  key_name: string;
}

/** Azure Key Vault provider configuration. */
interface BetaAzureExternalKeyConfigParam {
  type: "azure";
  /** Name of the key within the vault. */
  key_name: string;
  /** Azure AD tenant ID. */
  tenant_id: string;
  /** Key Vault data-plane URI — `https://{vault-name}.vault.azure.net` or `https://{hsm-name}.managedhsm.azure.net`. */
  vault_uri: string;
  /** Azure AD application (client) ID. Omit to use Anthropic's multitenant app. Provide only if using a single-tenant app registration in the customer's directory. */
  client_id?: string | null;
}

interface BetaExternalKeyAttachedAttachment {
  type: "attached";
}

interface BetaExternalKeyUnattachedAttachment {
  type: "unattached";
}

interface BetaAzureExternalKeyConfig {
  type: "azure";
  /** Name of the key within the vault. */
  key_name: string;
  /** Azure AD tenant ID. */
  tenant_id: string;
  /** Key Vault data-plane URI — `https://{vault-name}.vault.azure.net` or `https://{hsm-name}.managedhsm.azure.net`. */
  vault_uri: string;
  /** Azure AD application (client) ID. Omit to use Anthropic's multitenant app. Provide only if using a single-tenant app registration in the customer's directory. */
  client_id?: string | null;
}
```

### Validate External Key

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.externalKeys.validate(externalKeyID: string, options?: RequestOptions): ExternalKeyValidateResponse`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/external_keys/{external_key_id}/validate`

Validate an external key config against the customer's KMS.

Anthropic performs an encrypt/decrypt roundtrip against the configured
KMS key and waits up to 30 seconds for the result. The response status is
`success` if the roundtrip succeeded, or `failure` with an error
message if it failed or timed out.

#### Example request

```ts

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const response = await client.beta.organization.externalKeys.validate("external_key_id");

console.log(response.error);
```

```json
  "status": "failure",
  "type": "external_key_validation"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the External Key. */
externalKeyID: string; // path parameter, maxLength: 2048
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** Result of a validation roundtrip against the customer's KMS. HTTP 200 for both outcomes — the operation completed; `status` says whether the key works. */
interface ExternalKeyValidateResponse {
  type: "external_key_validation";
  /** Error message when status is `failure`. Null otherwise. */
  error: string | null;
  /** `success` — encrypt/decrypt roundtrip succeeded. `failure` — the roundtrip failed or timed out; see `error`. */
  status: "failure" | "success";
}
```

## Beta › Organization › Federation › Issuers

### Create Federation Issuer

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.federation.issuers.create(params: IssuerCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaFederationIssuer`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/federation_issuers`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Register an OIDC issuer that Anthropic will trust for workload identity
federation in your organization.

The `jwks` field controls how the issuer's signing keys are obtained and
takes one of three shapes selected by `type`: `discovery` (resolve keys
through OIDC discovery), `explicit_url` (fetch keys from a fixed JWKS
URL), or `inline` (provide a static key set). When `jwks.type` is
`discovery` and no `discovery_base` is set, the issuer URL must be
publicly reachable over HTTPS so Anthropic can fetch the discovery
document; for `explicit_url` and `inline` modes the issuer URL is only
matched as the JWT's `iss` claim and is not fetched.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaFederationIssuer = await client.beta.organization.federation.issuers.create({
  issuer_url: "x",
  name: "x"
});

console.log(betaFederationIssuer.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "fdis_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "archived_by_actor_id": "archived_by_actor_id",
  "check_jti": true,
  "created_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "created_by_actor_id": "created_by_actor_id",
  "issuer_url": "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com",
  "jwks": {
    "type": "discovery",
    "ca_cert_pem": "ca_cert_pem",
    "discovery_base": "discovery_base"
  },
  "jwks_polling_disabled_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "max_jwt_lifetime_seconds": 0,
  "name": "github-actions",
  "poll_status": {
    "consecutive_failures": 0,
    "last_fetched_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
    "next_poll_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
  },
  "type": "federation_issuer",
  "updated_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "updated_by_actor_id": "updated_by_actor_id"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface IssuerCreateParams {
  /** The `iss` claim value to match against. */
  issuer_url: string; // minLength: 1
  /** Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409. */
  name: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Whether the jwt-bearer exchange enforces JTI single-use (replay protection) for tokens from this issuer. Defaults to true. Applies only to assertions carrying a `jti` claim; tokens without one are accepted without single-use enforcement. */
  check_jti?: boolean | null;
  /** How signing keys are obtained. Defaults to OIDC discovery. */
  jwks?: BetaJWKSDiscovery | BetaJWKSExplicitURL | BetaJWKSInline;
  /** Maximum allowed iat→exp spread for assertions from this issuer (1-176400 seconds, i.e. up to 49h). Defaults to 3600 (1h). Assertions must carry both `iat` and `exp`; a missing `iat` is rejected. */
  max_jwt_lifetime_seconds?: number | null; // minimum: 1, maximum: 176400
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** Registered external OIDC identity provider. Records an external IdP the organization trusts for the RFC 7523 jwt-bearer grant. The `issuer_url` must match the JWT `iss` claim exactly. */
interface BetaFederationIssuer {
  type: "federation_issuer";
  /** Tagged ID of the federation issuer. */
  id: string;
  /** If set, all rules referencing this issuer reject token exchange. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this issuer. */
  archived_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** Whether the jwt-bearer exchange enforces JTI single-use (replay protection) for tokens from this issuer. Applies only to assertions carrying a `jti` claim; tokens without one are accepted without single-use enforcement. */
  check_jti: boolean;
  /** When this issuer was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this issuer. */
  created_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** The `iss` claim value. Incoming JWTs must match exactly. */
  issuer_url: string;
  /** How signing keys are obtained for signature verification. */
  jwks: BetaJWKSDiscovery | BetaJWKSExplicitURL | BetaJWKSInline;
  /** If set, Anthropic's JWKS poller has paused polling for this issuer after repeated fetch failures. Re-enable by sending `jwks_polling_disabled: false` via the issuer update endpoint (POST) once the upstream JWKS endpoint is fixed. An OAuth caller cannot send this when the issuer backs a rule with any scope other than `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; use a Console session. */
  jwks_polling_disabled_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Maximum allowed iat→exp spread for assertions from this issuer (1-176400 seconds, i.e. up to 49h). Assertions must carry both `iat` and `exp`; a missing `iat` is rejected. */
  max_jwt_lifetime_seconds: number;
  /** Admin-chosen slug identifier. */
  name: string;
  /** Live state of Anthropic's JWKS polling for this issuer. Populated on both single-issuer retrieval and list responses, including archived issuers. Typically null for inline-key issuers (no polling), or when poll status is temporarily unavailable or polling has not started yet. */
  poll_status: BetaFederationIssuerPollStatus | null;
  /** When this issuer was last updated. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this issuer. */
  updated_by_actor_id: string | null;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

#### Types

```ts
/** JWKS via the issuer's OIDC discovery document. */
interface BetaJWKSDiscovery {
  type: "discovery";
  /** Optional custom CA (PEM) for TLS verification of the JWKS fetch. */
  ca_cert_pem?: string | null; // maxLength: 8192
  /** Set when the discovery URL differs from `issuer_url`. */
  discovery_base?: string | null;
}

/** JWKS fetched from a fixed endpoint. */
interface BetaJWKSExplicitURL {
  type: "explicit_url";
  /** JWKS endpoint. */
  url: string; // minLength: 1
  /** Optional custom CA (PEM) for TLS verification of the JWKS fetch. */
  ca_cert_pem?: string | null; // maxLength: 8192
}

/** JWKS supplied directly; no network fetch. */
interface BetaJWKSInline {
  type: "inline";
  /** Inline JWK objects. */
  keys: Array<Record<string, unknown>>; // minItems: 1
}

interface BetaFederationIssuerPollStatus {
  /** Consecutive fetch failures since the last success. */
  consecutive_failures: number;
  /** When the last successful fetch completed. */
  last_fetched_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** When the next fetch is scheduled. Null if paused. */
  next_poll_at: string | null; // format: date-time
}
```

- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Create a federation rule owned by your organization.

The referenced issuer and the target service account must already exist
in the same organization; invalid references are rejected with a 400
error. The workspace reference is validated. Membership is not checked
at rule creation: token exchange resolves a single enabled workspace per
call and is rejected unless the target service account is a member of
that workspace (it is implicitly a member of the default workspace).
Rules on well-known shared issuers (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Buildkite,
Terraform Cloud, Google) must constrain tenant identity via an
identity-bearing claim, a tenant-pinning subject prefix (such as
`repo:YOUR_ORG/...`), or a CEL condition referencing one of those
identity claims (e.g. `claims.repository_owner`). OAuth callers may only
manage rules whose `oauth_scope` is `workspace:developer` or
`workspace:inference`; other scopes require a Console session.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaFederationRule = await client.beta.organization.federation.rules.create({
  issuer_id: "issuer_id",
  match: {},
  name: "x",
  oauth_scope: "x",
  target: { service_account_id: "svac_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK", type: "service_account" }
});

console.log(betaFederationRule.id);
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface RuleCreateParams {
  /** Tagged ID of the federation issuer. */
  issuer_id: string;
  /** Conditions the verified JWT must satisfy for this rule to apply. At least one of `subject_prefix` (other than a wildcard-only value like `*`), `claims`, or `condition` is required; `audience` alone is not sufficient. */
  match: BetaFederationRuleMatch;
  /** Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409. */
  name: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Space-separated OAuth scopes. OAuth callers may only set `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; other scopes (such as `org:admin`) require a Console session. */
  oauth_scope: string; // minLength: 1
  /** Identity that tokens minted via this rule act as. Currently always a `service_account` target. */
  target: BetaServiceAccountTarget;
  /** When true, enable this rule for every workspace in the org (including workspaces created later). */
  applies_to_all_workspaces?: boolean;
  /** CEL expressions `{name: expr}` extracting named values from claims. Not yet supported; any non-empty value is rejected with 400. */
  attributes?: Record<string, string> | null;
  /** Optional free-text description. */
  description?: string | null; // maxLength: 2000
  /** Lifetime in seconds for access tokens minted via this rule (60-86400). Defaults to 3600 (1h). Minted tokens are capped at `max(60, min(this value, 2 × remaining assertion validity))` seconds. */
  token_lifetime_seconds?: number; // minimum: 60, maximum: 86400
  /** Tagged ID of the workspace to enable this rule for. Required unless `applies_to_all_workspaces` is true. Additional workspaces can be added via the `/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces` sub-resource. */
  workspace_id?: string | null;
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** Authorization rule binding an external OIDC identity to Anthropic. Evaluates the match conditions and mints an OAuth access token for the resolved target, scoped to a single workspace where the rule is enabled (chosen by the caller at exchange time when the rule is enabled for more than one). For rules enabled via `workspace_ids` or `applies_to_all_workspaces`, the target service account must be a member of that workspace (it is implicitly a member of the default workspace); rules carrying only the legacy `workspace_id` binding do not enforce this. */
interface BetaFederationRule {
  type: "federation_rule";
  /** Tagged ID of the federation rule. */
  id: string;
  /** When true, this rule is enabled for every workspace in the org (including ones created after the rule). `workspace_ids` is ignored at exchange time. */
  applies_to_all_workspaces: boolean;
  /** If set, this rule is archived and rejects token exchange. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this rule. */
  archived_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** CEL expressions extracting named values from claims. Not yet supported; always null. */
  attributes: Record<string, string> | null;
  /** When this rule was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this rule. */
  created_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** Optional free-text description. */
  description: string | null;
  /** Tagged ID of the issuer whose tokens this rule accepts. */
  issuer_id: string;
  /** Issuer's display name at read time. */
  issuer_name: string | null;
  /** Conditions the verified JWT must satisfy for this rule to apply. All populated matcher fields must pass. */
  match: BetaFederationRuleMatch;
  /** Admin-chosen slug identifier. */
  name: string;
  /** Space-separated OAuth scopes granted on the minted token. */
  oauth_scope: string;
  /** What this rule targets. Check `type` before reading the other fields. Tokens minted via a rule whose target `type` is `service_account` act as that service account. */
  target: BetaServiceAccountTarget;
  /** Lifetime in seconds of access tokens minted via this rule. Minted tokens are capped at `max(60, min(this value, 2 × remaining assertion validity))` seconds. */
  token_lifetime_seconds: number;
  /** When this rule was last updated. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this rule. */
  updated_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** Legacy single-workspace binding. Prefer `workspace_ids` and the `/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces` sub-resource for managing workspace enablement. */
  workspace_id: string | null;
  /** Tagged IDs of the workspaces this rule is enabled for. May be empty for older rules that only carry the legacy `workspace_id` binding. Ignored at exchange time when `applies_to_all_workspaces` is true (the list may still be non-empty). */
  workspace_ids: Array<string>;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaFederationRuleMatch {
  /** Exact match against the `aud` claim (any element if array). When omitted, the JWT's `aud` must still equal Anthropic's expected audience for the issuer; setting this field overrides that default. */
  audience?: string | null; // maxLength: 1024
  /** Exact-match `{claim: value}` pairs against top-level claims. Only string-valued claims can be matched; use `condition` for non-string claims. */
  claims?: Record<string, string> | null;
  /** CEL expression over claims for logic the structural fields can't express. Must evaluate to a boolean and may reference only the `claims` variable; a constant-true expression (such as `true`) is rejected with 400. */
  condition?: string | null; // maxLength: 4096
  /** Match the verified JWT `sub` claim. Exact match unless the value ends with `*`, in which case it is a prefix match. Example: `repo:my-org/my-repo:ref:refs/heads/main`. */
  subject_prefix?: string | null; // maxLength: 1024
}

interface BetaServiceAccountTarget {
  type: "service_account";
  /** Tagged ID of the service account to mint tokens for. */
  service_account_id: string;
  /** Service account's display name at read time. Ignored on writes. */
  service_account_name?: string | null;
}
```

### Update Federation Rule

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.federation.rules.update(federationRuleID: string, params: RuleUpdateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaFederationRule`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Partially update a federation rule.

`issuer_id` is immutable. `match` and `target` are replaced as whole
objects when set. Referenced service accounts and workspaces must exist
in your organization; invalid references are rejected with a 400 error.
Archived rules cannot be updated; this returns 400. Create a new rule
instead. Rules on well-known shared issuers (GitHub Actions, GitLab,
Buildkite, Terraform Cloud, Google) must constrain tenant identity via
an identity-bearing claim, a tenant-pinning subject prefix (such as
`repo:YOUR_ORG/...`), or a CEL condition referencing one of those
identity claims (e.g. `claims.repository_owner`). On these issuers the
requirement is re-checked on every update; if an existing rule's stored
match does not yet constrain tenant identity, any update (even a rename
or description change) must also supply a conforming `match` in the same
request. OAuth callers may only manage rules whose `oauth_scope` is
`workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; other scopes require a
Console session.

```ts
});

const betaFederationRule = await client.beta.organization.federation.rules.update(
  "federation_rule_id",
  {}
);

console.log(betaFederationRule.id);
```

```ts
interface RuleUpdateParams {
  /** When true, enables this rule for every workspace in the org (including workspaces created later). Setting `false` is rejected with 400 if no workspace would remain enabled; a rule with only a legacy `workspace_id` binding continues to mint. */
  applies_to_all_workspaces?: boolean | null;
  /** Replaces the CEL expressions `{name: expr}` extracting named values from claims. Send null to clear them. Not yet supported; any non-empty value is rejected with 400. */
  attributes?: Record<string, string> | null;
  /** Replaces the description. Omit to leave unchanged; send `null` to clear (the field is stored as an empty string). */
  description?: string | null; // maxLength: 2000
  /** Replaces the entire match object. All populated matcher fields must pass. */
  match?: BetaFederationRuleMatch | null;
  /** Replaces the slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409. */
  name?: string | null; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Replaces the space-separated OAuth scopes granted on minted tokens. OAuth callers may only set `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`; other scopes (such as `org:admin`) require a Console session. */
  oauth_scope?: string | null; // minLength: 1
  /** Replaces the entire target object. Currently always a `service_account` target. */
  target?: BetaServiceAccountTarget | null;
  /** Replaces the lifetime in seconds for access tokens minted via this rule (60-86400). Minted tokens are capped at `max(60, min(this value, 2 × remaining assertion validity))` seconds. */
  token_lifetime_seconds?: number | null; // minimum: 60, maximum: 86400
  /** Replaces the existing single workspace enablement (the previous one is removed). Rejected with 400 if the rule is enabled for more than one workspace; use the `/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces` sub-resource instead. */
  workspace_id?: string | null;
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

### Archive Federation Rule

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.federation.rules.archive(federationRuleID: string, params?: RuleArchiveParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaFederationRule`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/archive`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Archive a federation rule.

Token exchange through this rule stops immediately. Idempotent;
re-archiving returns the rule with its original `archived_at`. Archiving
clears the rule's workspace targeting (`workspace_id` and
`workspace_ids` are emptied). Tokens already minted before archive
remain valid until they expire. OAuth callers may only manage rules
whose `oauth_scope` is `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`;
other scopes require a Console session.

```ts
  "federation_rule_id"
```

### Add Federation Rule Workspace

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.federation.rules.workspaces.add(federationRuleID: string, params: WorkspaceAddParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaFederationRuleWorkspace`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/federation_rules/{federation_rule_id}/workspaces`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Enable a federation rule for a workspace.

Idempotent; re-enabling returns the existing enablement. The rule and
workspace must both belong to your organization. Membership of the
rule's target service account in this workspace is not checked at
enablement: token exchange into this workspace is rejected unless the
target is a member (it is implicitly a member of the default workspace).
Archived rules are rejected with 400. OAuth callers may only manage rules
whose `oauth_scope` is `workspace:developer` or `workspace:inference`;
other scopes require a Console session.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});
```

## Beta › Organization › Invites

### Create Invite

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.invites.create(body: InviteCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaOrganizationInvite`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/invites`

Invite a user to join the organization by email.

On plans that draw members from a finite pool of purchased seats, the invite automatically consumes a seat from the lowest tier with availability; there is no seat-tier parameter. When no seat is free the request fails with a 400 error rather than purchasing a seat.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaOrganizationInvite = await client.beta.organization.invites.create({
  email: "user@emaildomain.com",
  role: "user"
});

console.log(betaOrganizationInvite.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "invite_015gWxCN9Hfg2QhZwTK7Mdeu",
  "accepted_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "email": "user@emaildomain.com",
  "expires_at": "2024-11-20T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "invited_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "rbac_group_ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "role": "admin",
  "status": "pending",
  "type": "invite"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface InviteCreateParams {
  /** Email of the User. */
  email: string; // format: email
  /** Role for the invited User. The accepted values depend on the organization type. Console and API organizations accept `user`, `developer`, `billing`, and `claude_code_user`; `admin` cannot be assigned through the API. Claude Enterprise organizations accept `user` and `managed`; inviting with the `managed` role requires the `write:rbac_groups` scope in addition to `write:members`. */
  role: "billing" | "claude_code_user" | "developer" | "managed" | "user";
  /** RBAC group IDs to assign to the User when the Invite is accepted. A non-empty array is accepted only for a Claude Enterprise organization with RBAC groups, and requires the key to carry the `write:rbac_groups` scope. */
  rbac_group_ids?: Array<string>; // maxItems: 100
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaOrganizationInvite {
  /** Object type. For Invites, this is always `"invite"`. */
  type: "invite";
  /** ID of the Invite. */
  id: string;
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Invite was accepted, or null. */
  accepted_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Email of the User being invited. */
  email: string;
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Invite expires. */
  expires_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Invite was created. */
  invited_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** RBAC group IDs recorded on the Invite (Claude Enterprise organizations), to be assigned to the User when the Invite is accepted. `[]` when none. */
  rbac_group_ids: Array<string>;
  /** Organization role of the User. */
  role: BetaOrganizationRole;
  /** Status of the Invite. */
  status: "accepted" | "deleted" | "expired" | "pending";
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `AlreadyMemberError` (HTTP status 400, error code `already_member`)

  The email address already belongs to a user in the organization. The message names the user.

- `CannotInviteEmailsWithUnverifiedDomainsError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cannot_invite_emails_with_unverified_domains`)

  The email address's domain is not one of the verified domains of the organization's parent organization.

- `EmailDomainNotAllowedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `email_domain_not_allowed`)

  The organization restricts invites to an allowed list of email domains, and the list is empty or does not include the email address's domain.

- `InviteAlreadyExistsError` (HTTP status 400, error code `invite_already_exists`)

  A pending invite already exists for the email address. The message names the invite.

- `OrgMemberLimitExceededError` (HTTP status 400, error code `org_member_limit_exceeded`)

  The organization has reached the member limit that Anthropic set for it. Pending invites count toward the limit.

- `RBACGroupGrantsOwnerAccessError` (HTTP status 400, error code `rbac_group_grants_owner_access`)

  A role attached to an RBAC Group in the request grants owner access, so this API does not add members to that group (directly or through an invite), remove its members, or delete it. Make the change in the organization's admin settings in Claude.

- `RBACGroupOwnerAccessUnconfirmedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `rbac_group_owner_access_unconfirmed`)

  The API could not finish checking whether an RBAC Group in the request grants owner access, so it made no change. Retrying the same request will not help. Make the change in the organization's admin settings in Claude.

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

#### Types

```ts
type BetaOrganizationRole = "admin" | "billing" | "claude_code_user" | "developer" | "managed" | "membership_admin" | "owner" | "primary_owner" | "user";
```

## Beta › Organization › Service Accounts

### Create Service Account

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.serviceAccounts.create(params: ServiceAccountCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaServiceAccount`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Create a service account.

A service account is a named workload identity that federation rules
target. `organization_role` is `developer` (default) or `admin`; a rule
may only be created or retargeted to grant `org:admin` scope when the
target's `organization_role` is `admin`. Creating an `admin`-role service
account requires an interactive credential (a user OAuth token or a
Console session) — a workload may only create `developer`-role service
accounts.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaServiceAccount = await client.beta.organization.serviceAccounts.create({
  name: "ci-deploy-bot"
});

console.log(betaServiceAccount.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "svac_01SDCCSbTxrXDpWc1phhtcfK",
  "archived_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "archived_by_actor_id": "archived_by_actor_id",
  "created_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "created_by_actor_id": "created_by_actor_id",
  "description": "description",
  "name": "ci-deploy-bot",
  "organization_role": "admin",
  "type": "service_account",
  "updated_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "updated_by_actor_id": "updated_by_actor_id"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface ServiceAccountCreateParams {
  /** Slug identifier (lowercase, digits, hyphens). Unique within the organization; a duplicate name returns 409. */
  name: string; // minLength: 1, maxLength: 255
  /** Optional free-text description. */
  description?: string | null; // maxLength: 2000
  /** Org-level role. Defaults to `developer`. */
  organization_role?: "admin" | "developer";
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** Named non-human identity within the caller's organization. A service account is a pure identity: name + org. Authorization lives on whatever references it (federation rules). */
interface BetaServiceAccount {
  type: "service_account";
  /** Tagged ID of the service account. */
  id: string;
  /** If set, this service account is archived. */
  archived_at: string | null; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that archived this service account. */
  archived_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** When this service account was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that created this service account. */
  created_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** Optional free-text description. */
  description: string | null;
  /** Admin-chosen slug identifier. */
  name: string;
  /** Org-level role. A federation rule may only be created or retargeted to grant `org:admin` scope when this is `admin`. A rule granting `org:admin` whose target is later demoted to `developer` is rejected at token exchange. Rules granting `org:admin` are managed in the Console. */
  organization_role: "admin" | "developer";
  /** When this service account was last updated. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Tagged ID (`user_`/`svac_`) of the actor that last updated this service account. */
  updated_by_actor_id: string | null;
}
```

## Beta › Organization › Service Accounts › Workspaces

### Add Workspace To Service Account

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.serviceAccounts.workspaces.add(serviceAccountID: string, params: WorkspaceAddParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaServiceAccountWorkspaceMember`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/workspaces`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

Add a service account to a workspace with the given `workspace_role`.

Mirror of `POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/service_accounts`, addressed
from the service-account side; both create the same membership. If the
service account is already an explicit member of the workspace, its
`workspace_role` is replaced with the value supplied here. Archived
workspaces return 400. Archived service accounts cannot be added and are
rejected.

```ts
});

    workspace_id: "workspace_id",
    workspace_role: "workspace_admin"
  });

console.log(betaServiceAccountWorkspaceMember.created_by_actor_id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "created_by_actor_id": "created_by_actor_id",
  "implicit": true,
  "service_account_id": "service_account_id",

  "workspace_id": "workspace_id",
  "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface WorkspaceAddParams {
  /** Tagged workspace ID to add the service account to. */

  workspace_role: BetaNoBillingWorkspaceRole;

  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
  type: "service_account_workspace_member";
  /** Tagged ID (`user_...`/`svac_...`) of the actor who created this membership. */
  created_by_actor_id: string | null;
  /** True when this is the implicit default-workspace membership every service account has when no explicit membership exists. Implicit memberships have role `workspace_user` and cannot be removed. */
  implicit: boolean | null;
  /** Tagged service account ID (`svac_...`). */
  service_account_id: string;
  /** Tagged workspace ID (`wrkspc_...`). */
  workspace_id: string;
  /** Role of the service account in this workspace. Service accounts cannot hold the `workspace_billing` role. */
  workspace_role: BetaWorkspaceRole;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).


### List Workspaces For Service Account

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.serviceAccounts.workspaces.list(serviceAccountID: string, params?: WorkspaceListParams, options?: RequestOptions): PageCursor<BetaServiceAccountWorkspaceMember>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/service_accounts/{service_account_id}/workspaces`

**Requires an OAuth access token with the `org:admin` scope**, from `ant auth login --scope org:admin` or a workload identity federation rule; Admin API keys are not accepted. See [Manage WIF with the Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/wif-admin-api?sdk_languages=typescript).

List the workspaces a service account is a member of.

Each entry includes the service account's `workspace_role` in that
workspace. Use `limit` and the `next_page` cursor to paginate. When the
service account has no explicit default-workspace membership, the
implicit (`implicit: true`) membership is returned as the first entry on
the first page; with `limit=1` the first page may return up to 2 entries
(the implicit entry plus one explicit membership) so a pagination cursor
can be derived. Memberships are returned only while
the service account is active. Without a `page` cursor, an archived
service account returns an empty list. A `page` cursor that does not
match an active membership returns a 400 invalid-request error. A cursor
stops matching when the membership is removed, the workspace is deleted,
or the service account is archived. Restart pagination from the first
page to recover.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaServiceAccountWorkspaceMember of client.beta.organization.serviceAccounts.workspaces.list(
  "service_account_id"
)) {
  console.log(betaServiceAccountWorkspaceMember.created_by_actor_id);
}
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "created_by_actor_id": "created_by_actor_id",
      "implicit": true,
      "service_account_id": "service_account_id",
      "type": "service_account_workspace_member",
      "workspace_id": "workspace_id",
      "workspace_role": "workspace_admin"
    }
  ],
  "next_page": "next_page"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the service account. */
serviceAccountID: string; // path parameter

interface WorkspaceListParams {
  /** Number of results per page. */
  limit?: number; // query parameter, minimum: 1, maximum: 100
  /** Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page`. */
  page?: string | null; // query parameter
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

```ts
);
```

### Sign Out User

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.users.signOut(userID: string, params?: UserSignOutParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaOrganizationUser`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/users/{user_id}/sign_out`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: admin-user-sign-out-2026-10-08`

Sign a member out of Claude everywhere, without removing them from the organization. This ends their sign-in sessions and removes their trusted devices wherever they use Claude, including other organizations and individual plans. It also ends the OAuth tokens issued to them for this organization, so apps such as Claude Code must sign in again.

A token can take up to an hour to stop working, though it almost always stops at once. The member keeps their role and can sign in again right away. To keep them out, remove them from the organization or, if your organization uses single sign-on, block them in your identity provider. Signing out does not end API keys, OAuth tokens that were not issued for this organization, or the member's Claude Code cloud sessions and routines.

You cannot sign out the organization's primary owner or the person your API key or token acts for, and a request to sign out another owner, a member with owner permissions, or a membership admin may be refused. A refused request returns a `400` or `403` error that says why. If the request returns `503`, send it again to finish; anything already ended stays ended.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: admin-user-sign-out-2026-10-08`. A request without it returns `400`. Sign-out is in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations. In an organization where it is not enabled, a request returns `400` with `error_code` `organization_not_enrolled_in_beta`. In a Claude Enterprise organization, an API key needs the `write:members` scope; a key without it gets `403`.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaOrganizationUser = await client.beta.organization.users.signOut("user_id");

console.log(betaOrganizationUser.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu",
  "added_at": "2024-10-30T23:58:27.427722Z",
  "email": "user@emaildomain.com",
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "role": "admin",
  "type": "user"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the User. */
userID: string; // path parameter

interface UserSignOutParams {
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `admin-user-sign-out-2026-10-08` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `BetaCannotSignOutPrimaryOwnerError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cannot_sign_out_primary_owner`)

  The member is the organization's primary owner, whom no API key or token can sign out.

- `BetaCannotSignOutSelfError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cannot_sign_out_self`)

  The member is the user the API key or token belongs to.

- `BetaOrganizationNotEnrolledInBetaError` (HTTP status 400, error code `organization_not_enrolled_in_beta`)

  The beta that the endpoint requires is not enabled for the organization. The message names the beta value.

- `BetaCannotSignOutManagedMemberError` (HTTP status 403, error code `cannot_sign_out_managed_member`)

  The member has the `managed` role, and this API key or token cannot sign them out. The error message says which keys and tokens can.

- `BetaCannotSignOutMembershipAdminError` (HTTP status 403, error code `cannot_sign_out_membership_admin`)

  The member is a membership admin, and the person the API key or token belongs to is not allowed to sign out membership admins.

- `BetaCannotSignOutOwnerError` (HTTP status 403, error code `cannot_sign_out_owner`)

  The member is an owner or has owner permissions, and this API key or token cannot sign them out. In a Claude Enterprise organization, an API key with the `write:members` scope can.

- `BetaCannotSignOutPrivilegedMemberError` (HTTP status 403, error code `cannot_sign_out_privileged_member`)

  This OAuth token cannot sign out a membership admin or a member whose roles grant owner, user management, or identity and access management.

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `ExternalKeyValidationFailedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `external_key_validation_failed`)

  The External Key failed Anthropic's validation, so the request was refused. The message gives the reason, if there is one.

- `ExternalKeyValidationTimedOutError` (HTTP status 400, error code `external_key_validation_timed_out`)

  Anthropic's validation of the External Key did not finish in time, so the request was refused. Wait a moment, then send the request again.

- `KeyProfileMismatchError` (HTTP status 400, error code `key_profile_mismatch`)

  The External Key is bound to a user profile, and the Workspace does not have that user profile. A Workspace can use only a key bound to its own user profile or a key that isn't bound to one.

- `UserProfileNotFoundError` (HTTP status 400, error code `user_profile_not_found`)

  The request depends on a user profile that does not exist in the organization or is no longer active. The request either names this user profile by ID, or names a resource, such as an External Key, that is bound to it.

- `WorkspacePolicyViolationError` (HTTP status 400, error code `workspace_policy_violation`)

  The request breaks the organization's Workspace Policy. The message says which rule it broke; an organization admin can see and change the policy in the Console.

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

- `ExternalKeyChangedError` (HTTP status 409, error code `external_key_changed`)

  The external key changed while the request was validating it. Send the request again.

```ts
  default_inference_geo?: "global" | "us" | null;
  /** Geographic region for workspace data storage. Immutable after creation. Defaults to 'us' if omitted. */
  workspace_geo?: "us" | null;
}
```
