```ts
  agent_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** API key that authenticated the requests, as a tagged API key ID, whichever identity `actor` resolves to. Populated only when `api_key_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage not authenticated by an API key. */
  api_key_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) spend category: `engaged` (a person addressed Claude in a channel or thread), `proactive` (Claude responded without being addressed), `scheduled` (a scheduled routine ran), `monitoring` (Claude watching a channel it was asked to monitor), or `dm` (direct messages with Claude). Populated only when `claude_tag_category` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag. New categories may be added over time. */
  claude_tag_category: BetaAnalyticsClaudeTagCategory | null;

Cannot be combined with `group_by[]=rbac_group_id` or the `rbac_group_ids[]` filter. */
  claude_tag_user_id: string | null;

  context_window: BetaAnalyticsContextWindow | null;

  deployment_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24

  environment_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24

  inference_geo: BetaAnalyticsUsageCostInferenceGeo | null;

  model: string | null;
  /** UUID of the child organization the usage belongs to, on a parent organization's report across its children. Null unless `organization_id` is in `group_by[]`. */
  organization_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24

  product: string | null;
  /** RBAC group (team) the usage is attributed to, in the public tagged `rbac_group_...` spelling — the same spelling the activity resources use for this key, so the same team has one id across resources and it round-trips as an `rbac_group_ids[]` filter value. Any-membership semantics: a user in several groups contributes their full usage to each of those groups' rows, so the named-group rows overlap and their sum can exceed the org total.   slack_channel_id: string | null;

  user_profile_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24

  workspace_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24

interface BetaAnalyticsUsageMetrics {
  /** The number of input tokens for cache creation. */
  cache_creation: BetaCacheCreation;
  /** The number of input tokens read from the cache. */
  cache_read_input_tokens: number;
  /** The number of output tokens generated. */
  output_tokens: number;
  /** Number of API requests in this row's scope. For sandbox / code-execution events, this counts execution spans rather than HTTP requests (these rows surface with `product: null`). */
  requests: number | null;
  /** Server-side tool usage metrics. */
  server_tool_use: BetaAnalyticsServerToolUse;
  /** Total token count across all token types. This is the value the default `order_by` (`total_tokens`) sorts on. */
  total_tokens: number;
  /** The number of uncached input tokens processed. */
  uncached_input_tokens: number;
}

interface BetaAnalyticsServerToolUse {
  /** The number of web search requests made. */
  web_search_requests: number;
}

type BetaAnalyticsActor = BetaAnalyticsReportUserActor | BetaAnalyticsServiceAccountActor | BetaAnalyticsFederatedActor | BetaAnalyticsAPIActor;

type BetaAnalyticsUsageCostInferenceGeo = "global" | "us";

interface BetaAnalyticsReportUserActor {
  /** Actor type. Always `"user_actor"`. */
  type: "user_actor";
  /** True when the account has been deleted, or when the user is no longer a member of the organization or its associated organizations (for example, their membership was removed or they were deprovisioned via your identity provider). `email_address` stays populated for removed users and is null when the account has been deleted. `name` follows the rules described on that field. The `user_id` is still populated for reconciliation. */
  deleted: boolean;
  /** The user's current email address, including for users who are no longer members of the organization. Null when the account has been deleted and for system-minted service accounts. */
  email_address: string | null;
  /** The user's current full name. Null when the user has not set one. `"Deleted User"` when the account has been deleted, or when the user is no longer a member and the organization hides removed users' names. */
  name: string | null;
  /** Tagged user ID. */
  user_id: string;
}

interface BetaAnalyticsServiceAccountActor {
  type: "service_account_actor";
  /** Tagged service account ID. */
  service_account_id: string;
}

interface BetaAnalyticsFederatedActor {
  type: "federated_actor";
  /** The trusted provider that asserted the caller's identity. */
  provider: BetaAnalyticsFederatedActorProvider;
  /** The provider's identifier for the caller: on `aws`, the IAM principal ARN (one role is one actor across its sessions); on `gcp`, the caller's IAM principal identifier as Google Cloud reports it, such as `serviceAccount:<email>`, `user:<email>`, or a `principal://...` URI. */
  subject: string | null;
```

## Beta › Organization › Analytics › Cost

### Get Cost By Dimension

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.analytics.cost.list(params: CostListParams, options?: RequestOptions): ReportPageCursor<BetaAnalyticsCostItem>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24`

Get cost in USD across a date range, broken out by dimension.

Returns one row per combination of the requested `group_by[]`
dimensions (and time bucket, when `time_bucket_width` is set) that has
cost in the range, ranked by spend or ordered by time bucket; every
combination is returned across pages. With no `group_by[]` and no
`time_bucket_width`, a single row aggregates the whole range. Includes
all cost, whether or not it is attributable to a seat user. Requires an
API key with the `read:analytics` scope, or an Admin API key.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaAnalyticsCostItem of client.beta.organization.analytics.cost.list({
  starting_at: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
})) {
  console.log(betaAnalyticsCostItem.cost);
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaAnalyticsCostItem {
  /** Cost for this row. */
  cost: BetaAnalyticsCostMetrics;
  /** End of the period this row covers (exclusive), as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp: the end of the row's time bucket when a time-bucket width is set; otherwise the requested `ending_at` (or, when omitted, the earlier of now and `starting_at` plus 31 days) rounded down to the hour, because without a time bucket the report covers whole hours. */
  ending_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** The dimension values this row's cost is broken out by. */
  group: BetaAnalyticsCostGroup;
  /** Start of the period this row covers (inclusive), as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp: the start of the row's time bucket when a time-bucket width is set, otherwise the requested `starting_at` rounded down to the hour. */
  starting_at: string; // format: date-time
}
```

#### Types

```ts
type BetaAnalyticsCostGroupBy = "actor" | "actor_type" | "agent_id" | "api_key_id" | "claude_tag_category" | "claude_tag_user_id" | "context_window" | "cost_type" | "deployment_id" | "environment_id" | "inference_geo" | "model" | "organization_id" | "product" | "rbac_group_id" | "service_tier" | "session_id" | "slack_channel_id" | "speed" | "token_type" | "user_profile_id" | "workspace_id";

type BetaAnalyticsCostOrderBy = "amount" | "list_amount" | "time";

interface BetaAnalyticsCostMetrics {
  /** Amount (post-discount, pre-credit) in fractional cents (minor units). */
  amount: string;
  /** Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always `"USD"`. */
  currency: string; // default: USD
  /** List-price amount (pre-discount) in fractional cents. */
  list_amount: string;
  /** Number of API requests in this row's scope. Null when `group_by` includes `cost_type` or `token_type` (the count has no per-component attribution; read it from the ungrouped response). For sandbox / code-execution events, this counts execution spans rather than HTTP requests (these rows surface with `product: null`). */
  requests: number | null;
}

interface BetaAnalyticsCostGroup {
  /** The identity the usage is attributed to: the user if one is attributed, else the service account, else the federated (cloud-platform) identity, else the API key. Populated only when `actor` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage with no attributable identity, and for users' and federated identities' usage when the reader is a member who can see only some workspaces. Distinct identities the server cannot render also read null, each as its own row. */
  actor: BetaAnalyticsActor | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Kind of identity the usage is attributed to; matches `actor.type` when `actor` is set. Populated only when `actor_type` is in `group_by[]`. */
  actor_type: BetaAnalyticsActorType | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Claude Managed Agents agent whose session incurred the usage. Populated only when `agent_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session. */
  agent_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** API key that authenticated the requests, as a tagged API key ID, whichever identity `actor` resolves to. Populated only when `api_key_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage not authenticated by an API key. */
  api_key_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) spend category: `engaged` (a person addressed Claude in a channel or thread), `proactive` (Claude responded without being addressed), `scheduled` (a scheduled routine ran), `monitoring` (Claude watching a channel it was asked to monitor), or `dm` (direct messages with Claude). Populated only when `claude_tag_category` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag. New categories may be added over time. */
  claude_tag_category: BetaAnalyticsClaudeTagCategory | null;
  /** Slack user ID (for example `U0123ABCDEF`) of the member the Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) usage is attributed to, not a claude.ai user ID. Populated only when `claude_tag_user_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag and for Claude Tag usage that is not attributed to a single user (for example `monitoring`, and `proactive` usage Claude initiated), so per-user rows can sum to less than the Claude Tag total. Cannot be combined with `group_by[]=rbac_group_id` or the `rbac_group_ids[]` filter. */
  claude_tag_user_id: string | null;
  /** Context-window pricing tier of the usage or cost. Null unless `context_window` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows with no context-window tier, such as code execution. */
  context_window: BetaAnalyticsContextWindow | null;
  /** Cost component breakdown; null when returning the combined total. */
  cost_type: BetaAnalyticsGroupedCostType | null;
  /** Deployment that started the Claude Managed Agents session. Populated only when `deployment_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session and for sessions no deployment started. */
  deployment_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Claude Managed Agents environment the session ran in. Populated only when `environment_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session. */
  environment_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Inference region of the usage or cost. Null unless `inference_geo` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows where the region is not set (the rows that `inference_geos[]=not_available` matches). */
  inference_geo: BetaAnalyticsUsageCostInferenceGeo | null;
  /** Model that produced the usage or cost, as a model name in the form the `models[]` filter accepts (for example, `claude-opus-5-5`). Null unless `model` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows whose usage or cost is not attributed to a specific model, such as code execution. */
  model: string | null;
  /** UUID of the child organization the usage belongs to, on a parent organization's report across its children. Null unless `organization_id` is in `group_by[]`. */
  organization_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Product surface that produced the usage or cost. Null unless product is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows whose usage cannot be attributed to a known surface. Values include `chat`, `claude_code`, `cowork`, `office_agent`, `claude_in_chrome`, `claude_design`, `claude_tag`, and `chat_cowork_unified`. `claude_tag` is Claude Tag, the Claude product in Slack. `chat_cowork_unified` is Chat and Cowork unified, Cowork's features inside claude.ai chat: chat and Cowork usage by a member who has it turned on is reported under this value instead of `chat` or `cowork`. It is accepted as a filter only where Chat and Cowork unified is available. Some unattributed usage is reported as "other". */
  product: string | null;
  /** RBAC group (team) the usage is attributed to, in the public tagged `rbac_group_...` spelling — the same spelling the activity resources use for this key, so the same team has one id across resources and it round-trips as an `rbac_group_ids[]` filter value. Populated only when `rbac_group_id` is in `group_by[]`. Any-membership semantics: a user in several groups contributes their full usage to each of those groups' rows, so the named-group rows overlap and their sum can exceed the org total. A null value is the single unassigned row: users in no group on that (UTC) day. For the true org total, run the same query without `group_by[]`. */
  rbac_group_id: string | null;
  /** Service tier the usage was served at. Populated only when `service_tier` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage with no service tier (for example, code execution) and for Claude Enterprise usage. */
  service_tier: BetaAnalyticsServiceTier | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Claude Managed Agents session that incurred the usage. Populated only when `session_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside a managed session. */
  session_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Slack channel the usage originated from. Populated only when `slack_channel_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside Slack, for some Claude Tag usage that has no channel recorded, and for usage recorded before channel attribution was enabled. */
  slack_channel_id: string | null;
  /** Inference speed mode of the usage or cost: `fast` or `standard`. Null unless `speed` is in `group_by[]`. */
  speed: BetaAnalyticsSpeed | null;
  /** Token type when `cost_type` is `tokens`; null otherwise. */
  token_type: BetaAnalyticsTokenType | null;
  /** User profile the usage was attributed to, as a tagged `uprof_` ID. Populated only when `user_profile_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that named no profile and for Claude Enterprise usage. */
  user_profile_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
  /** Workspace the usage occurred in, as a tagged workspace ID, including the organization's default workspace. Populated only when `workspace_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for Claude Enterprise usage. */
  workspace_id: string | null; // beta header: analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24
}

type BetaAnalyticsGroupedCostType = "code_execution" | "session_usage" | "tokens" | "web_search";

type BetaAnalyticsTokenType = "cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens" | "cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens" | "cache_read_input_tokens" | "output_tokens" | "uncached_input_tokens";
```

## Beta › Organization › Analytics › Usage Report

### Get Token Usage Over Time

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.analytics.usageReport.list(query: UsageReportListParams, options?: RequestOptions): ReportPageCursor<BetaAnalyticsUsageReportTimeBucket>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/usage_report`

[Legacy] Get token usage over time across a date range.

Returns token usage bucketed by minute, hour, or day, optionally broken down by one or more `group_by[]` dimensions, such as product or model. Available to organizations on a Claude Enterprise plan. Requires an API key with the `read:analytics` scope.

This endpoint is one of the legacy Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports. For new integrations, use [`GET /v1/organizations/analytics/usage`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/usage/list?sdk_languages=typescript) in the Usage and Cost Analytics API instead. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api?sdk_languages=typescript#migrate-from-enterprise-analytics-reports).

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaAnalyticsUsageReportTimeBucket of client.beta.organization.analytics.usageReport.list(
  { starting_at: "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z" }
)) {
  console.log(betaAnalyticsUsageReportTimeBucket.ending_at);
}
```

```ts
  /** Filter to Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) usage attributed to specific Slack users, by Slack user ID (for example `U0123ABCDEF`), not claude.ai user ID.   ending_at?: string | null; // query parameter, format: date-time
  /** Dimensions to break each time bucket out by. Defaults to no grouping (one total per bucket). Each bucket reports at most its top 100 groups; a group beyond that cap has no row in that bucket (there is no remainder row), so grouped buckets are not exhaustive when a dimension has more than 100 distinct values. */
  group_by?: Array<"claude_tag_category" | "claude_tag_user_id" | "context_window" | "inference_geo" | "model" | "product" | "rbac_group_id" | "slack_channel_id" | "speed"> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to specific inference regions. `not_available` matches rows where the region is unset. Use `group_by[]=inference_geo` to break out per-region values. */
  inference_geos?: Array<BetaAnalyticsInferenceGeoFilter> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100

  /** Product surfaces to include. Defaults to all products. Use `group_by[]=product` to break out per-product values. */
  products?: Array<BetaAnalyticsProductFilter> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to usage attributed to specific RBAC groups. Accepts tagged RBAC group IDs (`rbac_group_...`) or bare group UUIDs. A row matches when the user belonged to any of the listed groups on the (UTC) day the usage occurred; usage with no group attribution never matches. */
  rbac_group_ids?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
```

```ts
  product: string | null;

Populated only when `rbac_group_id` is in `group_by[]`. Any-membership semantics: a user in several groups contributes their full usage to each of those groups' rows, so the named-group rows overlap and their sum can exceed the org total.   speed: "fast" | "standard" | null;

  uncached_input_tokens: number;
}
```

## Beta › Organization › Analytics › User Usage Report

### Get Per-User Token Usage

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.analytics.userUsageReport.list(query: UserUsageReportListParams, options?: RequestOptions): ReportPageCursor<BetaAnalyticsUsageUsersItem>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/user_usage_report`

[Legacy] Get per-user token usage across a date range.

Returns usage per user, ranked by the chosen token metric; `group_by[]` or `bucket_width` splits a user across several rows. Use this to see which users consume the most tokens. Only usage attributed to a user account is included, so usage with no user account, such as Code Review usage and Claude Tag usage in Slack channels, is left out. Claude Tag one-to-one direct messages are included, with product `claude-tag`, only for members who have connected a Claude account. Available to organizations on a Claude Enterprise plan. Requires an API key with the `read:analytics` scope.

This endpoint is one of the legacy Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports. For new integrations, use [`GET /v1/organizations/analytics/usage`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/usage/list?sdk_languages=typescript) in the Usage and Cost Analytics API instead. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api?sdk_languages=typescript#migrate-from-enterprise-analytics-reports).

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaAnalyticsUsageUsersItem of client.beta.organization.analytics.userUsageReport.list(
  { starting_at: "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z" }
)) {
  console.log(betaAnalyticsUsageUsersItem.claude_tag_user_id);
}
```

```ts
interface BetaAnalyticsUserActor {

The `user_id` is still populated for reconciliation. */
  deleted: boolean;
  /** The user's email address, including for users who are no longer members of the organization or its associated organizations. Null when the account has been deleted (check `deleted`) and for system-minted service accounts, which have no person's mailbox behind them (check `name`). */
  email_address: string | null;

Returns `"Deleted User"` when the account itself has been deleted, or when the user is no longer a member of the organization or its associated organizations and the organization has chosen to hide the names of removed users. Otherwise, the name stays populated for removed users. Rows for system-minted service accounts render the service name (for example, `"Claude Security"`) or null. */

  user_id: string;
```

```ts
  ending_at?: string | null; // query parameter, format: date-time
  /** Dimensions to break each time bucket out by. Defaults to no grouping (one total per bucket). Each bucket reports at most its top 100 groups; a group beyond that cap has no row in that bucket (there is no remainder row), so grouped buckets are not exhaustive when a dimension has more than 100 distinct values. */
  group_by?: Array<"claude_tag_category" | "claude_tag_user_id" | "context_window" | "cost_type" | "inference_geo" | "model" | "product" | "rbac_group_id" | "slack_channel_id" | "speed" | "token_type"> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to specific inference regions. `not_available` matches rows where the region is unset. Use `group_by[]=inference_geo` to break out per-region values. */
  inference_geos?: Array<BetaAnalyticsInferenceGeoFilter> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Maximum number of time buckets per page. Defaults and caps vary by `bucket_width` (`1d`: default 7, max 31; `1h`: default 24, max 168; `1m`: default 60, max 256). */
  limit?: number | null; // query parameter, minimum: 1
  /** Models to include. Defaults to all models. Use `group_by[]=model` to break out per-model values. */
  models?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page` field. */
  page?: string | null; // query parameter
  /** Product surfaces to include. Defaults to all products. Use `group_by[]=product` to break out per-product values. */
  products?: Array<BetaAnalyticsProductFilter> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to usage attributed to specific RBAC groups. Accepts tagged RBAC group IDs (`rbac_group_...`) or bare group UUIDs. A row matches when the user belonged to any of the listed groups on the (UTC) day the usage occurred; usage with no group attribution never matches. */
  rbac_group_ids?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to usage originating from specific Slack channels. Use `group_by[]=slack_channel_id` to break out per-channel values. */
  slack_channel_ids?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to fast or standard inference mode. Use `group_by[]=speed` to break out per-mode values. */
  speeds?: Array<"fast" | "standard"> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Filter to specific users by tagged user ID. */
  user_ids?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
}
```

```ts
}
```

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaAnalyticsCostBucketedResult {
  /** Amount (post-discount, pre-credit) in fractional cents. */
  amount: string;

Populated only when `claude_tag_category` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage that is not Claude Tag. New categories may be added over time. */
  claude_tag_category: BetaAnalyticsClaudeTagCategory | null;

Cannot be combined with `group_by[]=rbac_group_id` or the `rbac_group_ids[]` filter. */
  claude_tag_user_id: string | null;
  /** Context-window pricing tier of the usage or cost. Null unless `context_window` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows with no context-window tier, such as code execution. */
  context_window: BetaAnalyticsContextWindow | null;
  /** Cost component when `group_by[]=cost_type`; null otherwise (amount is the combined total). */
  cost_type: BetaAnalyticsCostType | null;
  /** Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always `"USD"`. */
  currency: string; // default: USD
  /** Inference region of the usage or cost. Null unless `inference_geo` is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows where the region is not set (the rows that `inference_geos[]=not_available` matches). */
  inference_geo: "global" | "us" | null;
  /** List-price amount (pre-discount) in fractional cents. */
  list_amount: string;

  model: string | null;
  /** Product surface that produced the usage or cost. Null unless product is in `group_by[]`; it can also be null on grouped rows whose usage cannot be attributed to a known surface. Values include `chat`, `claude_code`, `cowork`, `office_agent`, `claude_in_chrome`, `claude_design`, `claude-tag`, and `chat_cowork_unified`. `claude-tag` is Claude Tag, the Claude product in Slack. `chat_cowork_unified` is Chat and Cowork unified, Cowork's features inside claude.ai chat: chat and Cowork usage by a member who has it turned on is reported under this value instead of `chat` or `cowork`. It is accepted as a filter only where Chat and Cowork unified is available. Some unattributed usage is reported as "other". */
  product: string | null;
  /** RBAC group (team) the usage is attributed to, in the public tagged `rbac_group_...` spelling — the same spelling the activity resources use for this key, so the same team has one id across resources and it round-trips as an `rbac_group_ids[]` filter value. Populated only when `rbac_group_id` is in `group_by[]`. Any-membership semantics: a user in several groups contributes their full usage to each of those groups' rows, so the named-group rows overlap and their sum can exceed the org total. A null value is the single unassigned row: users in no group on that (UTC) day. For the true org total, run the same query without `group_by[]`. */
  rbac_group_id: string | null;
  /** Number of API requests in this row's scope. Null when `group_by` includes `cost_type` or `token_type` (the count has no per-component attribution; read it from the ungrouped response).   requests: number | null;
  /** Slack channel the usage originated from. Populated only when `slack_channel_id` is in `group_by[]`; null for usage outside Slack, for some Claude Tag usage that has no channel recorded, and for usage recorded before channel attribution was enabled. */
  slack_channel_id: string | null;
  /** Inference speed mode of the usage or cost: `fast` or `standard`. Null unless `speed` is in `group_by[]`. */
  speed: "fast" | "standard" | null;
  /** Token type when `group_by[]=token_type` and `cost_type=tokens`; null otherwise. */
  token_type: BetaAnalyticsTokenType | null;
}

type BetaAnalyticsCostType = "code_execution" | "tokens" | "web_search";
```

## Beta › Organization › Analytics › User Cost Report

### Get Per-User Cost

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.analytics.userCostReport.list(query: UserCostReportListParams, options?: RequestOptions): ReportPageCursor<BetaAnalyticsCostUsersItem>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/user_cost_report`

[Legacy] Get per-user cost in USD across a date range.

Returns cost per user, ranked by spend; `group_by[]` or `bucket_width` splits a user across several rows. Use this to see which users account for the most cost. Only cost attributed to a user account is included, so cost with no user account, such as Code Review usage and Claude Tag usage in Slack channels, is left out. Claude Tag one-to-one direct messages are included, with product `claude-tag`, only for members who have connected a Claude account. Available to organizations on a Claude Enterprise plan. Requires an API key with the `read:analytics` scope.

This endpoint is one of the legacy Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports. For new integrations, use [`GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/cost/list?sdk_languages=typescript) in the Usage and Cost Analytics API instead. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api?sdk_languages=typescript#migrate-from-enterprise-analytics-reports).

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaAnalyticsCostUsersItem of client.beta.organization.analytics.userCostReport.list(
  { starting_at: "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z" }
)) {
  console.log(betaAnalyticsCostUsersItem.claude_tag_user_id);
}
```

## Beta › Organization › Spend Limits

### Set Spend Limit

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.spendLimits.set(params: SpendLimitSetParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaSpendLimit`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/spend_limits`

Set a spend limit.

Upsert keyed on (scope, period): setting a limit that already exists
overwrites it in place. A Claude Enterprise organization sets `user`
limits. Its seat-tier, group, and organization-level defaults are configured
in claude.ai. A Claude Console organization sets `organization` and
`workspace` limits, which are monthly and always carry an amount. Setting those
limits is in an early access preview. To request access, contact your
Anthropic account team.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaSpendLimit = await client.beta.organization.spendLimits.set({
  amount: "50000",
  scope: { type: "user", user_id: "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu" }
});

console.log(betaSpendLimit.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "id",
  "amount": "50000",
  "created_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z",
  "currency": "USD",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "period": "daily",
  "scope": {
    "type": "user",
    "user_id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
  },
  "type": "spend_limit",
  "updated_at": "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface SpendLimitSetParams {
  /** Limit amount as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of the organization's billing currency (cents for USD): "50000" is $500.00. `null` sets an explicit no-limit override for this scope and `period` only — each period resolves independently, so caps for other periods still apply. */
  amount: string | null;
  /** What the limit applies to. Claude Enterprise organizations set `user` limits. Claude Console organizations set `organization` and `workspace` limits. Any other combination returns 400. Setting `organization` and `workspace` limits through the API is in an early access preview. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team. */
  scope: BetaSpendLimitUserScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationScope | BetaSpendLimitWorkspaceScope;
  period?: BetaSpendLimitPeriod;
  /** Optional header to specify the beta version(s) you want to use. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** A configured spend limit: a cap on metered spend for one scope and period. */
interface BetaSpendLimit {
  /** Object type. Always `spend_limit`. */
  type: "spend_limit";
  /** Unique tagged ID of the spend limit (`spl_...`). */
  id: string;
  /** Limit amount as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of `currency` (cents for USD): "50000" is $500.00. `null` means no numeric cap is configured at this scope — see the effective report for whether a limit applies. */
  amount: string | null;
  /** RFC 3339 datetime at which the spend limit was created. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency; the unit for `amount`. */
  currency: string;
  /** Read-only. `false` when extra usage is switched off for this organization (`organization` limit); `amount` is kept and applies again when it's switched back on. Always `true` for other limits. */
  is_enabled: boolean;
  /** Length of the window the limit resets over. `amount` caps spend within each period. */
  period: BetaSpendLimitPeriod;
  /** What the limit applies to. A tagged union on `type`; each variant carries the identifier for its scope. */
  scope: BetaSpendLimitUserScope | BetaSpendLimitSeatTierScope | BetaSpendLimitRBACGroupScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationServiceScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationScope | BetaSpendLimitWorkspaceScope | BetaSpendLimitUsageTierScope;
  /** RFC 3339 datetime at which the spend limit was last modified. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

- `BetaSpendLimitsAdminAPIWritesNotEnabledError` (HTTP status 403, error code `spend_limits_admin_api_writes_not_enabled`)

  The organization cannot retrieve, set or delete spend limits with an Admin API credential.

#### Types

```ts
/** Scope selecting a single member of the organization. */
interface BetaSpendLimitUserScope {
  /** Scope type. Always `user` for this scope. */
  type: "user";
  /** Tagged ID of the member the spend limit applies to. */
  user_id: string;
}

interface BetaSpendLimitOrganizationScope {
  type: "organization";
}

/** Scope selecting one workspace of a Claude Console organization. */
interface BetaSpendLimitWorkspaceScope {
  /** Scope type. Always `workspace` for this scope. */
  type: "workspace";
  /** Tagged ID of the workspace the spend limit applies to. */
  workspace_id: string;
}

type BetaSpendLimitPeriod = "daily" | "monthly" | "weekly";

interface BetaSpendLimitSeatTierScope {
  type: "seat_tier";
  seat_tier: string;
}

interface BetaSpendLimitRBACGroupScope {
  type: "rbac_group";
  rbac_group_id: string;
}

interface BetaSpendLimitOrganizationServiceScope {
  type: "organization_service";
  service: string;
}

/** Scope of the monthly spend cap Anthropic sets for a Claude Console organization from its usage tier, or a higher cap Anthropic granted the organization.   type: "usage_tier";
}
```

### Delete Spend Limit

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.spendLimits.delete(spendLimitID: string, options?: RequestOptions): SpendLimitDeleteResponse`
- Endpoint: `DELETE /v1/organizations/spend_limits/{spend_limit_id}`

Delete a spend limit.

For a Claude Enterprise organization, this deletes a per-user override, and
the member falls back to any inherited spend limit at that period. Its
seat-tier, group, and organization-level rows cannot be deleted via this
endpoint. A Claude Console organization deletes its organization and
workspace limits, but not its `usage_tier` limit. Deleting organization and
workspace limits through the API is in an early access preview.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const spendLimit = await client.beta.organization.spendLimits.delete("spend_limit_id");

console.log(spendLimit.id);
```

```json
  "id": "id",
  "type": "spend_limit_deleted"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the Spend Limit. */

```

#### Returns

```ts
interface SpendLimitDeleteResponse {
  type: "spend_limit_deleted";
  id: string;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `SandboxEgressRestrictedError` (HTTP status 403, error code `sandbox_egress_restricted`)

  The request came from a Claude sandbox with restricted network access, which is not allowed to make this change. Send it from outside the sandbox, or from a sandbox with unrestricted network access.

- `BetaSpendLimitsAdminAPIWritesNotEnabledError` (HTTP status 403, error code `spend_limits_admin_api_writes_not_enabled`)

  The organization cannot retrieve, set or delete spend limits with an Admin API credential.

### List Spend Limits

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.spendLimits.list(params?: SpendLimitListParams, options?: RequestOptions): PageCursor<BetaSpendLimit>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/spend_limits`

List the organization's spend limits.

A Claude Console organization's limits, including any read-only `usage_tier`
limit, come newest first. Listing them is in an early access preview. To
request access, contact your Anthropic account team. A Claude Enterprise
organization's limits are grouped by scope type, in the order `organization`,
`seat_tier`, `rbac_group`, `organization_service`, `user`; within a type they
come in a fixed order that is not creation order.

```ts
}
```

```ts
interface SpendLimitListParams {

  limit?: number; // query parameter, minimum: 1, maximum: 1000
  /** Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page` field. */
  page?: string | null; // query parameter
  /** Return only limits with these scope types. Omit for all. A scope type that doesn't apply to the organization gets a 400 error. */
  scope_type?: Array<"organization" | "organization_service" | "rbac_group" | "seat_tier" | "usage_tier" | "user" | "workspace"> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
  /** Return only the limits whose `scope.workspace_id` is this workspace (`wrkspc_...`). Claude Console organizations only; other organizations get a 400 error. */

}
```

## Beta › Organization › Spend Limits › Effective

### List Effective Spend Limits

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.spendLimits.effective.list(query?: EffectiveListParams, options?: RequestOptions): PageCursor<BetaSpendSummary>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/spend_limits/effective`

List each member's effective spend limit and period-to-date spend.

Returns one row per (member, period) the member resolves a spend limit
for, with the `source` scope the spend limit was inherited from.
Paginates by member, so a member's periods never split across pages.
Supported for Claude Enterprise organizations only, not for Claude Console
organizations.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaSpendSummary of client.beta.organization.spendLimits.effective.list()) {
  console.log(betaSpendSummary.spend_limit_id);
}
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "actor": {
        "deleted": true,
        "email_address": "email_address",
        "name": "name",
        "type": "user_actor",
        "user_id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
      },
      "amount": "50000",
      "currency": "USD",
      "period": "daily",
      "period_to_date_spend": "12050.5",
      "scope": {
        "type": "user",
        "user_id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
      },
      "source": {
        "type": "user",
        "user_id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
      },
      "spend_limit_id": "spend_limit_id"
    }
  ],
  "next_page": "next_page"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface EffectiveListParams {
  /** Maximum number of members per page. A member's period rows never split across pages, so a page may carry more rows than this. Defaults to `20`. */
  limit?: number; // query parameter, minimum: 1, maximum: 1000
  /** Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page` field. */
  page?: string | null; // query parameter
  /** Restrict the report to these limit periods. Omit to return one row per period each member resolves a spend limit for. */
  period?: Array<BetaSpendLimitPeriod> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 3
  /** Restrict the report to these members, by tagged user ID (`user_...`). At most 100 entries. */
  user_ids?: Array<string> | null; // query parameter, maxItems: 100
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
/** Per-member effective-limit report row (`GET /spend_limits/effective`). */
interface BetaSpendSummary {
  actor: BetaSpendLimitUserActor | BetaSpendLimitScopedAPIKeyActor;
  /** Effective limit amount as a non-negative integer decimal string in the minor unit of `currency` (cents for USD). `null` means no limit applies for this row's `period` — each period resolves independently, so another period may still cap this member. */
  amount: string | null;
  /** ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency; the unit for `amount` and `period_to_date_spend`. */
  currency: string;
  /** Period this row's effective limit and spend are reported for. */
  period: BetaSpendLimitPeriod;
  /** The member's spend so far in the current period, as a non-negative decimal string in the minor unit of `currency` (cents for USD). May carry fractional minor units up to three decimal places (e.g. `"12050.5"`) — metered usage is not rounded to whole cents. Reads as `"0"` when the spend reading is temporarily unavailable. */
  period_to_date_spend: string;
  scope: BetaSpendLimitUserScope | BetaSpendLimitSeatTierScope | BetaSpendLimitRBACGroupScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationServiceScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationScope | BetaSpendLimitWorkspaceScope | BetaSpendLimitUsageTierScope;
  source: BetaSpendLimitUserScope | BetaSpendLimitSeatTierScope | BetaSpendLimitRBACGroupScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationServiceScope | BetaSpendLimitOrganizationScope | BetaSpendLimitWorkspaceScope | BetaSpendLimitUsageTierScope;
  spend_limit_id: string;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `OrganizationTypeNotSupportedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `organization_type_not_supported`)

  The endpoint does not support the organization's type. Each endpoint's description says which organization types it supports.

#### Types

```ts
/** A user within the organization. `name` and `email_address` are null when the underlying account is unavailable or has been deleted; `deleted` is true only for deleted accounts. */
interface BetaSpendLimitUserActor {
  /** Actor type. Always `user_actor`. */
  type: "user_actor";
  /** True only when the underlying account has been deleted. */
  deleted: boolean; // default: false
  /** The user's email address. Null when the account is unavailable or has been deleted. */
  email_address: string | null;
  /** The user's current display name. Null when the account is unavailable, has been deleted, or has no name set. */
  name: string | null;
  /** Tagged ID of the user. */
  user_id: string;
}

/** A scoped Admin API key acting on behalf of the organization. */
interface BetaSpendLimitScopedAPIKeyActor {
  type: "scoped_api_key_actor";
  scoped_api_key_id: string;
}
```

```ts
  /** Action the permission grants on the resource. The vocabulary follows the resource: an `organization` grant carries a product-feature entitlement (for example `chat`), an admin-panel permission entitlement (`permission_*`), or a blanket capability-access mode — `capability_access_all` grants every product-feature entitlement except `inference_hooks_inspection`, which a role holds only through its own row, and `capability_access_all_ga` grants the subset of those for stable features as it stands at permission-check time; neither mode grants model-access entitlements. A consumer enumerating a role's per-feature grants should treat a blanket row as granting every product-feature entitlement it covers, or it will under-report the role's effective access. A `connector_tool` grant carries a tool-access action (`use` or `always_allow`); a `connector_scope` grant carries the scope action `grant` (the role may receive the named OAuth scope when tokens are minted for the connector); `connector` and `all_connectors` grants carry a tool-access action, the scope action, or an authentication-method action (`interactive` or `managed`). */
  action: string;
  /** What the permission applies to. A tagged union: `type` names the kind of resource and determines which identifier fields are present. */
  resource: BetaRBACOrganizationPermissionResource | BetaRBACConnectorToolPermissionResource | BetaRBACConnectorScopePermissionResource | BetaRBACConnectorPermissionResource | BetaRBACAllConnectorsPermissionResource;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `OrganizationTypeNotSupportedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `organization_type_not_supported`)

  The endpoint does not support the organization's type. Each endpoint's description says which organization types it supports.

- `ParentOrganizationRequiredError` (HTTP status 400, error code `parent_organization_required`)

  The endpoint serves only organizations that belong to a parent organization, and this organization belongs to none.

- `RBACRoleNotFoundError` (HTTP status 404, error code `rbac_role_not_found`)

  No RBAC Role with this ID was found.

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaRBACOrganizationPermissionResource {
  /** Kind of resource the permission applies to. */
  type: "organization";
  /** UUID of the organization the permission applies to. */
  organization_id: string;
}

interface BetaRBACConnectorToolPermissionResource {
  /** Kind of resource the permission applies to. */
  type: "connector_tool";
  /** ID of the connector the permission applies to. */
  connector_id: string;
  /** Published name of the connector tool the permission applies to. When the published name contains characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]` (or collides with a reserved form), it is server-encoded into a stable `{prefix}_{32-hex}` form — a shortened readable prefix of the name plus a hash — from which the published name is not recoverable. */
  tool_name: string;
}

interface BetaRBACConnectorScopePermissionResource {
  /** Kind of resource the permission applies to. */
  type: "connector_scope";
  /** ID of the connector the permission applies to. */
  connector_id: string;
  /** OAuth scope the permission names — the role may receive this scope when tokens are minted for the connector. Subject to the same encoding rule as `tool_name`: a scope containing characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_-]` (or colliding with a reserved form) appears server-encoded in a stable `{prefix}_{32-hex}` form. OAuth scopes routinely contain `:` and `/`, so most appear encoded. */
  scope: string;
}

interface BetaRBACConnectorPermissionResource {
  /** Kind of resource the permission applies to. */
  type: "connector";
  /** ID of the connector the permission applies to. */
  connector_id: string;
}

interface BetaRBACAllConnectorsPermissionResource {
  /** Kind of resource the permission applies to. */
  type: "all_connectors";
}
```

## Beta › Organization › Plugins

### Create Plugin

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.create(params: PluginCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaPlugin`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/plugins`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

Create an organization-owned Plugin and its first version by uploading the
version's files.

The upload is `multipart/form-data`: the version's files (`files`, each part sent
as `files[]`), with an optional `marketplace_id` and `release_notes`. The manifest's `name` becomes the
Plugin's `name`, and `display_name`, `description` and `manifest_version` come
from the manifest too.

`name` may contain lowercase letters (from any alphabet), digits, and hyphens, up
to 64 characters. Uppercase letters, spaces, underscores, and other punctuation are
rejected.

The `name` must be unique within the marketplace: a name already taken
returns a 409 with `error_code` `plugin_name_taken` and, when a Plugin holds it,
that Plugin's ID in `details.plugin_id`. A Plugin going into the organization's
library marketplace is also refused with a 409 when one of its skills has the name of
an organization skill that this API does not list: `error_code`
`skill_name_taken`, with that name in `details.skill_name`; rename the skill, or
remove the organization skill in claude.ai. A 503 with `error_code`
`registration_pending` means the Plugin and its version were stored (their IDs are
in `details`) but are not yet usable in claude.ai: do not retry the create (the
retry would return `plugin_name_taken`); create a version on the stored Plugin
instead, which completes it.

For a worked example, see [Create a plugin](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/plugins-api?sdk_languages=typescript#create-a-plugin)
in the Plugins API guide.

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `write:plugins` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import fs from "fs";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaPlugin = await client.beta.organization.plugins.create({
  files: [fs.createReadStream("path/to/file")]
});

console.log(betaPlugin.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "plugin_01JyHfbRkZvD1gW7oTqXc3Ne",
  "components": [
    {
      "description": "description",
      "name": "review-pr",
      "type": "skill"
    }
  ],
  "content_scan": {
    "assessment": "warn",
    "reason": "credential-exposure",
    "status": "completed"
  },
```

#### Parameters

```ts
interface PluginCreateParams {
  /** The version's files: one part per file, the part's filename being the file's path within the Plugin (for example `skills/review-pr/SKILL.md`), or a single `.zip` or `.plugin` archive holding them all. On the wire each part is named `files[]`, and a part named plain `files` is not read; with cURL, `-F 'files[]=@SKILL.md;filename=skills/review-pr/SKILL.md'`. The files must include the manifest, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. */
  files: Array<Uploadable>;
  /** ID of the organization-owned plugin marketplace to create the Plugin in (prefixed `marketplace_`). It must be a `manual` marketplace, one whose Plugins are uploaded rather than synchronized from a repository. When omitted, the Plugin is created in the organization's library marketplace, an organization-owned `manual` marketplace created on first use. */
  marketplace_id?: string;
  /** Release notes stored with the version and shown in its version history in claude.ai; up to 5,000 characters. */
  release_notes?: string; // maxLength: 5000
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `ce-plugins-2026-09-01` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaPlugin {
  /** Always `plugin`. */
  type: "plugin";
  /** The Plugin's ID. */
  id: string;
  /** What the served version contains; null when not enumerated. */
  components: Array<BetaPluginComponent> | null;
  /** The served version's content scan; null when it has not been scanned. */
  content_scan: BetaPluginContentScan | null;
  /** RFC 3339. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Who created the Plugin; null when no creator is recorded. */
  created_by: BetaPluginUserActor | BetaPluginAPIActor | null;
  /** The served version's description. */
  description: string | null;
  /** The served version's display name. */
  display_name: string | null;
  /** The newest version. */
  latest_version_id: string;
  /** The served version's manifest `version`, normalized for display, or `null` (the Plugin Version's `manifest_version` says how and when). */
  manifest_version: string | null;
  /** The ID of the plugin marketplace the Plugin lives in. */
  marketplace_id: string;
  /** Lowercase identifier, unique within its plugin marketplace. Fixed for an organization-owned Plugin's lifetime; a member-owned Plugin's changes when its owner renames it in claude.ai, while its `id` stays the same. */
  name: string;
  /** Organization-owned Plugin: the organization-wide installation setting every member gets unless an RBAC Group they belong to holds its own — the Plugin's own setting, or its plugin marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned Plugin, which has shares instead. One of `required`, `auto_install`, `available`, `not_available`; a value this API does not yet name is returned as stored. */
  organization_installation_preference: "auto_install" | "available" | "not_available" | "required" | null;
  /** Organization-owned Plugin: true while it has no organization-wide setting of its own and `organization_installation_preference` is its plugin marketplace's default. Null for a member-owned Plugin. */
  organization_installation_preference_inherited: boolean | null;
  /** Who owns the Plugin: the organization, or the member whose personal plugin marketplace it lives in. */
  owner: BetaPluginOwnerOrganization | BetaPluginOwnerUser;
  /** How far the served version reaches, or `null` if it is not classified. `remote` means it declares an MCP server or a CLI, or something that counts as one. `privileged` means it is not `remote`, but declares a hook (of any type, even one that posts to a URL), monitor, language server, Claude Code workflow (any file in a `workflows/` folder at its root counts as one), or settings, or has a skill, command, or other Markdown file whose frontmatter pre-approves tools (`allowed-tools` with any value other than an empty one or one that names only `AskUserQuestion`, `TodoWrite`, and `ToolSearch`). Otherwise it is `contained`. If the frontmatter of a skill, command, or other Markdown file that could change the value could not be read, or was past a size limit, the version is `null` or `privileged` (or `remote`, if something else it declares makes it `remote`), not `contained`. The value is normally worked out when a version is stored, under the rules of that time, so an older version can be `null`, `contained` where the same files stored today would be `privileged`, `remote`, or `null`, or `privileged` where they would be `remote`. */
  reach: "contained" | "privileged" | "remote" | null;
  /** The version claude.ai serves to members. */
  served_version_id: string;
  /** True once the served version has been pinned, through Update Plugin or in claude.ai. While false, a new version normally becomes the served version when it is stored. While the newest version is not the served version, as when a version saved in claude.ai is waiting for its content scan, `served_version_id` differs from `latest_version_id`. */
  served_version_pinned: boolean;
  /** RFC 3339. Moves on a served-version change (including pinning an unpinned Plugin to the version it already serves) and, normally, on a new version. A version saved in claude.ai that waits for its content scan moves it when it becomes the served version, and not necessarily when it is stored. A change to the Plugin's installation settings or shares does not move it. */
  updated_at: string; // format: date-time
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `CMEKKeyDisabledError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_disabled`)

  The workspace's customer-managed encryption key is disabled or revoked. Re-enable the key, then retry.

- `CMEKKeyNetworkBlockedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_network_blocked`)

  The key management service's network access controls blocked the request to the workspace's customer-managed encryption key. The key itself may be healthy.

- `BetaUnsupportedCharsetError` (HTTP status 400, error code `unsupported_charset`)

  The request's `Content-Type` header names a charset other than UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII. Send the request with no charset, or with one of these.

- `BetaPluginNameTakenError` (HTTP status 409, error code `plugin_name_taken`)

  The marketplace already holds this name. `plugin_id` is the Plugin that holds it, and can be absent.

- `BetaSkillNameTakenError` (HTTP status 409, error code `skill_name_taken`)

  One of the Plugin's skills has the name of an organization skill. `skill_name` is that name.

- `BetaRegistrationPendingError` (HTTP status 503, error code `registration_pending`)

  The Plugin version was stored but is not yet usable in claude.ai. `plugin_id` and `plugin_version_id` identify what was stored.

#### Types

```ts
interface BetaPluginComponent {
  /** The kind of component. */
  type: "agent" | "cli" | "command" | "hook" | "mcp_server" | "skill";
  /** What the component declares about itself; always null for MCP servers, hooks, and CLIs. */
  description: string | null;
  /** The component's name: a skill's, command's or agent's name, an MCP server's key in the manifest, the event a hook runs on, or a CLI's executable. */
  name: string;
}

interface BetaPluginContentScan {
  /** The scan's verdict; set only when `status` is `completed`. A `warn` can mean a `fail` that was allowed in claude.ai. */
  assessment: "fail" | "pass" | "unknown" | "warn" | null;
  /** The primary mechanism behind a `warn` or `fail`, such as `credential-exposure` or `guardrail-tampering`; a mechanism this API does not yet name reads as `other`. Null on a `pass`, whenever `assessment` is null, and when no mechanism is reported for the verdict. */
  reason: string | null;
  /** `processing` while a scan runs, `completed` when it ran to completion, `errored` when it could not run. Once a scan of the version has completed, `content_scan` describes the newest completed scan, even while a later scan runs. While the scan outcome cannot be read, `status` is `errored` instead. */
  status: "completed" | "errored" | "processing";
}

interface BetaPluginUserActor {
  /** A member of the organization. */
  type: "user_actor";
  /** The member's email address; may be null, for example when they are no longer a member of the organization. */
  email_address: string | null;
  /** The member's User ID. */
  user_id: string;
}

interface BetaPluginAPIActor {
  /** An Admin API key, in the same form the Compliance API activity feed uses for it. */
  type: "api_actor";
  /** The key's ID. */
  api_key_id: string;
}

interface BetaPluginOwnerOrganization {
  /** The Plugin lives in a plugin marketplace the organization owns. */
  type: "organization";
}

interface BetaPluginOwnerUser {
  /** The Plugin lives in one member's personal plugin marketplace. */
  type: "user";
  /** The member's User ID. */
  user_id: string;
}
```

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `read:plugins` or `read:org_audit` scope, or a Compliance Access Key with the `read:compliance_org_data` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. ### Update Plugin

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.update(pluginID: string, params: PluginUpdateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaPlugin`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

Change which stored version of an organization-owned Plugin is served to members,
for example to roll back to an earlier one. This pins the served version: later
uploads are stored but no longer change what is served, and pinning cannot currently
be undone, here or in claude.ai.

Pass the version as `served_version_id`: an earlier one to roll back, a later one to
start serving a version that was stored without being served, or the one already
served to pin it without changing what is served. No new version is created.

When the organization has content scanning enabled, a version whose
`content_scan.status` is `processing` is refused with a 409 (`error_code`
`scan_pending`; retry once the scan finishes). A version whose `content_scan.status`
is `errored`, or whose `content_scan.assessment` is `fail` or `unknown`, is refused
with a 400 (`error_code` `scan_failed`); a `warn` is accepted. If the scan outcome
cannot be read at that moment, the request fails with a retryable 503 instead.
When the Plugin is in the organization's
library marketplace, a version other than the one served is also refused with a 409
when an organization skill that this API does not list has since taken the name of
one of its skills: `error_code` `skill_name_taken`, with that name in
`details.skill_name`. A member-owned Plugin cannot be updated here (403).

This endpoint does not write installation settings; they are written at
`/v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}/installation_settings/{target}`.

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `write:plugins` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaPlugin = await client.beta.organization.plugins.update("plugin_id", {
  served_version_id: "pluginver_01KaZmQpRsTuVwXyZ2b4c6d8"
});

console.log(betaPlugin.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "plugin_01JyHfbRkZvD1gW7oTqXc3Ne",
  "components": [
    {
      "description": "description",
      "name": "review-pr",
      "type": "skill"
    }
  ],
  "content_scan": {
    "assessment": "warn",
    "reason": "credential-exposure",
    "status": "completed"
  },
  "created_at": "2026-03-14T09:26:53.589793Z",
  "created_by": {
    "email_address": "user@example.com",
    "type": "user_actor",
    "user_id": "user_01WxYzAbCdEfGhJkMnPqRsTu"
  },
  "description": "Reviews pull requests against your team's conventions.",
  "display_name": "Code Review Helper",
  "latest_version_id": "pluginver_01KaZmQpRsTuVwXyZ2b4c6d8",
  "manifest_version": "1.2.0",
  "marketplace_id": "marketplace_01HxQ3v9KpZ2mTn8RwLc4Ys7",
  "name": "code-review-helper",

  "updated_at": "2026-03-14T09:26:53.589793Z"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts
/** ID of the Plugin (prefixed `plugin_`). */
pluginID: string; // path parameter

interface PluginUpdateParams {
  /** Serve this version of the Plugin (prefixed `pluginver_`) and pin the served version to it; `latest` is not accepted. */
  served_version_id: string;
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `ce-plugins-2026-09-01` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `CMEKKeyDisabledError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_disabled`)

  The workspace's customer-managed encryption key is disabled or revoked. Re-enable the key, then retry.

- `CMEKKeyNetworkBlockedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_network_blocked`)

  The key management service's network access controls blocked the request to the workspace's customer-managed encryption key. The key itself may be healthy.

- `BetaScanFailedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `scan_failed`)

  The version in `plugin_version_id` did not pass its content scan, so it cannot be served.

- `BetaScanPendingError` (HTTP status 409, error code `scan_pending`)

  The content scan of the version in `plugin_version_id` is still running. Retry once the scan finishes.

- `BetaSkillNameTakenError` (HTTP status 409, error code `skill_name_taken`)

  One of the Plugin's skills has the name of an organization skill. `skill_name` is that name.

### List Plugins

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.list(params?: PluginListParams, options?: RequestOptions): PageCursor<BetaPlugin>`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/plugins`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

List the Plugins created under the organization, newest first: those in the
organization's own plugin marketplaces and those in members' personal plugin
marketplaces.

Plugins in members' personal marketplaces are listed with the same detail as the
organization's own, and their files can be downloaded through the version archive
endpoint, which records each such download on the Compliance API activity feed.

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `read:plugins` or `read:org_audit` scope, or a Compliance Access Key with the `read:compliance_org_data` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

// Automatically fetches more pages as needed.
for await (const betaPlugin of client.beta.organization.plugins.list()) {
  console.log(betaPlugin.id);
}
```

### Delete Plugin

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.delete(pluginID: string, params?: PluginDeleteParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaDeletedPlugin`
- Endpoint: `DELETE /v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

Permanently delete a Plugin and every version it holds, exactly as when an
administrator deletes it in claude.ai. The Plugin may belong to the organization or
to a member, including a member who has since left the organization. Do not delete a
Plugin only because your pipeline did not create it: a member or an administrator
might have added it in claude.ai.

An organization-owned Plugin's installation settings go with it; a member-owned
Plugin's shares are withdrawn and its owner no longer has it.

To take an organization-owned Plugin out of use reversibly, set its
organization-wide installation setting to `not_available` instead (and
remove or change any group settings, which override it for their members). Only a
Plugin in a `manual` marketplace can be deleted here; one synchronized from a
repository is removed by removing it from the repository (400).

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `write:plugins` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaDeletedPlugin = await client.beta.organization.plugins.delete("plugin_id");

console.log(betaDeletedPlugin.id);
```

#### Example response (200)

```json
{
  "id": "plugin_01JyHfbRkZvD1gW7oTqXc3Ne",
  "type": "plugin_deleted"
}
```

#### Parameters

```ts

interface PluginDeleteParams {
  /** This endpoint is in beta: requests must send `ce-plugins-2026-09-01` in this header. */
  betas?: Array<AnthropicBeta>; // header parameter
}
```

#### Returns

```ts

  /** Always `plugin_deleted`. */
  type: "plugin_deleted";
  /** The deleted Plugin's ID. */
  id: string;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `CMEKKeyDisabledError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_disabled`)

  The workspace's customer-managed encryption key is disabled or revoked. Re-enable the key, then retry.

## Beta › Organization › Plugins › Versions

### Create Plugin Version

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.versions.create(pluginID: string, params: VersionCreateParams, options?: RequestOptions): BetaPluginVersion`
- Endpoint: `POST /v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}/versions`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

Add a version to an organization-owned Plugin by uploading the new version's
files; it becomes the version served to members unless the Plugin's served version
has been pinned.

The upload is the same `multipart/form-data` as creating a Plugin: the version's
files (`files`, each part sent as `files[]`) and optional `release_notes`. The uploaded manifest's `name`
must equal the Plugin's `name`. Returns the stored version; read the Plugin back to
see which version it serves.

Only a Plugin in a `manual` marketplace takes uploads; a Plugin synchronized from
a repository gets its versions from the repository. When the Plugin is in the
organization's library marketplace, a version that adds a skill with the name of an
organization skill that this API does not list is refused with a 409: `error_code`
`skill_name_taken`, with that name in `details.skill_name`. A 503 with `error_code`
`registration_pending` means the version was stored but is not yet usable; a later
version create on the Plugin completes it.

For a worked example, see [Create a version](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/plugins-api?sdk_languages=typescript#create-a-version)
in the Plugins API guide.

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `write:plugins` scope.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import fs from "fs";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const betaPluginVersion = await client.beta.organization.plugins.versions.create("plugin_id", {
  files: [fs.createReadStream("path/to/file")]
});

console.log(betaPluginVersion.id);
```

```json
    }
```

```ts
interface VersionCreateParams {
  /** The version's files: one part per file, the part's filename being the file's path within the Plugin (for example `skills/review-pr/SKILL.md`), or a single `.zip` or `.plugin` archive holding them all. On the wire each part is named `files[]`, and a part named plain `files` is not read; with cURL, `-F 'files[]=@SKILL.md;filename=skills/review-pr/SKILL.md'`. The files must include the manifest, `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`. */
  files: Array<Uploadable>;
  /** Release notes stored with the version and shown in its version history in claude.ai; up to 5,000 characters. */
```

#### Returns

```ts
interface BetaPluginVersion {
  /** Always `plugin_version`. */
  type: "plugin_version";
  /** The version's ID. */
  id: string;
  /** What the version contains; null when not enumerated. */
  components: Array<BetaPluginComponent> | null;
  /** This version's content scan; null when it has not been scanned. */
  content_scan: BetaPluginContentScan | null;
  /** RFC 3339. */
  created_at: string; // format: date-time
  /** Who uploaded this version; null when not recorded. */
  created_by: BetaPluginUserActor | BetaPluginAPIActor | null;
  /** The manifest's description; null when it declares none. The value can be longer than 500 characters, the limit on `description` in an uploaded manifest. A description that the manifest takes from a `SKILL.md` is cut to its first 500 characters. So if the manifest's description is the first 500 characters of exactly one distinct skill `description` in `components`, that skill `description` is returned instead. */
  description: string | null;
  /** The manifest's display name; null when it declares none. */
  display_name: string | null;
  /** The manifest's `version`, normalized for display: one leading `v` or `V` is dropped, and the result is returned only if it is 1 to 64 characters, starts with a digit, and uses only ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `+`, and `-`; otherwise `null`. For example, `"v1.4.0"` is returned as `"1.4.0"`, and `"latest"` as `null`. For a synchronized plugin, the `version` of its `marketplace.json` entry can take the place of the manifest's `version`. It is also `null` for a version stored before claude.ai began recording this field (August 2026). */
  manifest_version: string | null;
  /** The Plugin's ID. */
  plugin_id: string;
  /** How far the version reaches: `remote`, `privileged`, `contained`, or `null`, as defined on the Plugin's `reach`. */
  reach: "contained" | "privileged" | "remote" | null;
  /** As supplied with the upload; null when none were supplied. */
  release_notes: string | null;
}
```

#### Errors

Any method can also return the general [HTTP errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors?sdk_languages=typescript).

- `CMEKKeyDisabledError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_disabled`)

  The workspace's customer-managed encryption key is disabled or revoked. Re-enable the key, then retry.

- `CMEKKeyNetworkBlockedError` (HTTP status 400, error code `cmek_key_network_blocked`)

  The key management service's network access controls blocked the request to the workspace's customer-managed encryption key. The key itself may be healthy.

- `BetaUnsupportedCharsetError` (HTTP status 400, error code `unsupported_charset`)

  The request's `Content-Type` header names a charset other than UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII. Send the request with no charset, or with one of these.

- `BetaSkillNameTakenError` (HTTP status 409, error code `skill_name_taken`)

  One of the Plugin's skills has the name of an organization skill. `skill_name` is that name.

- `BetaRegistrationPendingError` (HTTP status 503, error code `registration_pending`)

  The Plugin version was stored but is not yet usable in claude.ai. `plugin_id` and `plugin_version_id` identify what was stored.

### Download Plugin Version Archive

- Signature: `client.beta.organization.plugins.versions.download(version: string, params: VersionDownloadParams, options?: RequestOptions): Response`
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/organizations/plugins/{plugin_id}/versions/{version}/content`
- Beta header: `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`

Download one version's `.zip` archive, exactly as stored. Each download of a
Plugin from a member's personal plugin marketplace is recorded on the Compliance API
activity feed.

The response body is the archive (`Content-Type: application/zip`), sent as an
attachment whose filename is derived from the Plugin's name; name saved files from
the IDs in the request path, since that filename is not unique.

**Accepted credentials:** an Admin API key with the `read:plugins` or `read:org_audit` scope, or a Compliance Access Key with the `read:compliance_org_data` scope.

Every read scope above (`read:plugins`, `read:org_audit`, and
`read:compliance_org_data`) can download the files of plugins in members' personal
marketplaces, including files that claude.ai's admin settings do not show, and a
`read:org_audit` or `read:compliance_org_data` key created for all of your parent
organization's linked organizations can do this in any organization under it that has
access to this API, by passing `organization_id`. Each such download records a
`claude_plugin_archive_accessed` event on the Compliance API activity feed,
identifying the key, the plugin, the version, and the member. Downloads of
organization-owned plugins are not recorded.

Every request must include the beta header `anthropic-beta: ce-plugins-2026-09-01`. A request without it returns `404`, exactly as if the endpoint did not exist. The Plugins API is in beta and is available to Claude Enterprise organizations only. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations, or to organizations with HIPAA readiness enabled.

#### Example request

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"] // This is the default and can be omitted
});

const response = await client.beta.organization.plugins.versions.download("version", {
  plugin_id: "plugin_id"
});

console.log(response);

const content = await response.blob();
console.log(content);
```
